purpose: 藥對 as first-class records rather than a flat list hanging off one herb. A pair belongs to BOTH herbs, carries its own meaning (why these two), and is the unit formulas are actually built and taught from - so the real chain is 方劑 -> 藥對 -> 單味藥, navigable in every direction.

schema_note.relation: id from data/config/herb_pair_relations.json (七情配伍) - this is what makes it a 藥對 and not just two names
schema_note.pair_meaning: what the pair achieves that neither herb achieves alone - the actual teaching content
schema_note.found_in_formulas: formula ids where this pair does the work, so the formula card can show its pairs

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Gui Zhi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 兩藥皆能發汗解表。麻黃開腠理、發汗力峻，桂枝解肌發表、溫通經脈助營衛之氣外達。相須為用，發汗解表之力大增，為風寒表實無汗的核心組合。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Both release the exterior. Ma Huang forcefully opens the pores; Gui Zhi releases the muscle layer and warms the channels. Used together they mutually accentuate, creating the core combination for Wind-Cold excess with no sweating.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒表實證：惡寒發熱、無汗、頭身疼痛、脈浮緊
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Cold excess pattern: chills and fever, absence of sweating, body aches, tight floating pulse
pairs.caution_zh: 發汗力強，表虛自汗、陰虛、體弱者不宜；不可過汗。
pairs.caution_en: Strongly diaphoretic - unsuitable for exterior deficiency with spontaneous sweating, yin deficiency, or debility.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Xing Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃宣發肺氣以開，杏仁肅降肺氣以降。一宣一降，恢復肺的宣降之常，止咳平喘之力遠勝單用。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang disseminates and opens Lung qi; Xing Ren directs Lung qi downward. One ascends and one descends, restoring normal Lung diffusing and descending.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺氣壅遏之咳嗽氣喘，無論寒熱皆可隨證配伍
pairs.indication_en: Cough and wheezing from obstructed Lung qi; adaptable to either cold or heat patterns with appropriate partners.
pairs.caution_zh: 杏仁有小毒，用量宜慎；嬰幼兒尤須注意。
pairs.caution_en: Xing Ren is slightly toxic; dose carefully.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Shi Gao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃辛溫宣肺發汗，石膏辛甘大寒清熱瀉火。石膏清解麻黃之熱，麻黃宣發石膏之鬱，清肺平喘而不傷正。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang is warm and diffuses Lung qi; Shi Gao is cold and clears interior heat. Shi Gao checks Ma Huang's heat, while Ma Huang prevents Shi Gao from cloying.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺熱喘咳：發熱、口渴、咳嗽氣急、甚或鼻翼煽動
pairs.indication_en: Lung heat asthma and cough: fever, thirst, rapid breathing, flaring nostrils.
pairs.caution_zh: 體虛無熱者不宜。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable for patients with cold or deficiency without heat.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Shi Gao with Zhi Mu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 石膏大寒清氣分實熱，知母滋陰潤燥清虛實熱。兩藥相須為用，清熱瀉火而不傷陰，為清氣分大熱之要藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shi Gao clears excess heat in the qi level; Zhi Mu nourishes yin and clears heat. Used together they clear heat and purge fire without consuming yin.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣分熱盛：壯熱、大汗、大渴引飲、脈洪大（白虎湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Qi level heat excess: high fever, profuse sweating, extreme thirst, flooding pulse (Bai Hu Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、真寒假熱者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Spleen/Stomach cold deficiency or false heat.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Huang Lian with Rou Gui
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 黃連苦寒瀉心火，肉桂辛熱補命門火引火歸元。一寒一熱，水火既濟，交泰心腎，治療心腎不交之失眠
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huang Lian drains Heart fire; Rou Gui warms Kidney yang and leads fire back to its source. Cold and hot balance to communicate Heart and Kidney.
pairs.indication_zh: 心腎不交證：虛煩不寐、心悸怔忡、腰膝酸軟、頭暈耳鳴（交泰丸證）
pairs.indication_en: Heart-Kidney disharmony: insomnia from irritability, palpitations, sore knees, tinnitus (Jiao Tai Wan pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺甚者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use with caution in severe Yin deficiency with flaming fire.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Huang Lian with Wu Zhu Yu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 黃連苦寒瀉肝火、清胃熱，吳茱萸辛熱疏肝下氣、降逆止嘔。黃連重而吳茱萸輕，清肝瀉火、和胃止嘔（左金丸）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huang Lian clears Liver fire and Stomach heat; Wu Zhu Yu warms the Liver and directs rebellious qi downward. Clears Liver and harmonizes Stomach.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝火犯胃證：脅肋疼痛、嘈雜吞酸、嘔吐呃逆、口苦（左金丸證）
pairs.indication_en: Liver fire attacking Stomach: hypochondriac pain, acid reflux, vomiting, bitter taste (Zuo Jin Wan pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 胃熱嘔吐無肝火者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable for Stomach heat vomiting without Liver fire involvement.

pairs.name_en: Dang Gui with Huang Qi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 黃芪重用大補脾肺之氣以資生血之源，當歸甘溫養血活血。氣旺則血生，氣血雙補，為氣虛血弱之核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huang Qi heavily tonifies qi to generate blood; Dang Gui nourishes and invigorates blood. Strong qi generates blood (Dang Gui Bu Xue Tang).
pairs.indication_zh: 血虛發熱、氣血兩虛證：肌熱面赤、煩渴引飲、目昏頭暈、神疲乏力
pairs.indication_en: Blood deficiency fever or dual Qi-Blood deficiency: hot skin, pale face, fatigue, dizziness.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、實熱發熱者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with interior heat or excess heat.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Dang Gui with Chuan Xiong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 當歸主養血和血，川芎主行氣活血。當歸血中聖藥，川芎血中氣藥，一養一行，血和氣順，為婦科養血調經核心藥對（四物湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dang Gui nourishes blood; Chuan Xiong moves qi and invigorates blood. One nourishes and one moves, harmonizing blood and regulating qi.
pairs.indication_zh: 血虛血瘀證：月經不調、痛經、經閉、產後惡露不盡、頭痛痛風
pairs.indication_en: Blood deficiency with blood stasis: irregular menstruation, dysmenorrhea, amenorrhea, postpartum lochia.
pairs.caution_zh: 月經過多、出血性疾病者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use with caution in menorrhagia or bleeding disorders.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Chai Hu with Bai Shao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 柴胡辛散疏肝理氣，白芍酸收養血柔肝止痛。一散一收，疏肝而不傷陰，柔肝而不滯氣，為調和肝脾、疏肝止痛之經典藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chai Hu spreads and courses Liver Qi; Bai Shao nourishes Blood, softens the Liver, and relieves pain. One disperses and one restrains, coursing the Liver without damaging Yin and softening without stagnating Qi.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝鬱血虛、肝脾不和證：胸脅脹痛、情志抑鬱、腹痛下利、月經不調。
pairs.indication_en: Liver Qi stagnation with Blood deficiency or Liver-Spleen disharmony: hypochondriac distention, emotional constraint, abdominal pain with diarrhea, and irregular menses.
pairs.caution_zh: 肝陽上亢、陰虛津虧或肝火上炎者慎用/禁用柴胡方向；依柴胡安全欄辨證。
pairs.caution_en: Use or avoid the Chai Hu direction carefully in Liver Yang rising, Yin/Fluid deficiency, or Liver Fire flaring upward; follow the Chai Hu safety panel.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Fu Zi with Gan Jiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 附子走而不守、走十二經走走命門大補陽氣；乾薑守而不走、溫脾胃散中寒。附子得乾薑則溫陽散寒之力大增，走守兼備，為回陽救逆之第一要藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Zi travels without staying to warm the Gate of Life; Gan Jiang stays without traveling to warm the Stomach. Together they revive yang.
pairs.indication_zh: 心腎陽虛、寒邪直中：四肢厥逆、神疲欲寐、吐瀉腹痛、脈微欲絕（四逆湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Heart-Kidney Yang collapse: cold limbs, extreme fatigue, vomiting/diarrhea, faint pulse (Si Ni Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 真熱假寒、陰虛陽亢者禁用；附子有毒，須先煎。
pairs.caution_en: Forbidden in true heat with false cold. Fu Zi is toxic and requires prolonged decocting.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Fu Zi with Rou Gui
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 附子大辛大熱補命門火，肉桂溫補腎陽引火歸元。兩藥同用，溫補下元、大補命門火，為治療腎陽虛衰、命門火衰之核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Zi tonifies Gate of Life fire; Rou Gui warms Kidney yang and leads fire back. Together they strongly warm the lower jiao and Gate of Life.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽虛衰、命門火衰證：腰膝冷痛、畏寒肢冷、陽痿遺精、小便頻數水腫
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency: cold knees, aversion to cold, impotence, nocturnal emissions, frequent urination, edema.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、孕婦忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with flaming fire and during pregnancy.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Fu Ling with Zhu Ling
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 茯苓淡滲利濕、健脾寧心；豬苓專於淡滲利水。兩藥相須為用，利水滲濕之力大增，且茯苓能補脾，使利水而不傷脾氣。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ling leaches out dampness and strengthens Spleen; Zhu Ling specifically promotes urination. Together they strongly promote urination without injuring Spleen.
pairs.indication_zh: 水濕內停證：小便不利、水腫、腹瀉、小便短赤（五苓散證）
pairs.indication_en: Water-damp retention: urinary difficulty, edema, diarrhea, scanty reddish urine (Wu Ling San pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛無濕、津液虧虛者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable for Yin deficiency without dampness or fluid deficit.

pairs.name_en: Jin Yin Hua with Lian Qiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 金銀花清熱解毒、善清肺胃之熱；連翹清熱解毒、善散上焦風熱透達表裡。兩藥相須，清熱解毒、疏散風熱之力顯著，為溫病初起之核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jin Yin Hua clears heat and resolves toxicity; Lian Qiao clears heat and disperses upper jiao wind-heat. Core pair for warm disease exterior heat.
pairs.indication_zh: 溫病初起、風熱感冒：發熱、微惡風寒、頭痛、口渴、咽喉腫痛（銀翹散證）
pairs.indication_en: Early warm disease or Wind-Heat cold: fever, slight chills, headache, thirst, sore throat (Yin Qiao San pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、大便溏薄者不宜久服。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable for long-term use in Spleen/Stomach cold deficiency.

pairs.name_en: Qing Hao with Bie Jia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 青蒿芳香透絡、清透陰分伏熱；鱉甲咸寒滋陰、深入陰分搜邪。青蒿得鱉甲不致空透，鱉甲得青蒿不致凝滯，透熱陰分而不傷陰（青蒿鱉甲湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Qing Hao vents latent heat from the yin level; Bie Jia nourishes yin and reaches deep to search for pathogens. Together they clear deep heat without injuring yin.
pairs.indication_zh: 溫病後期夜熱早涼、熱退無汗、骨蒸潮熱（青蒿鱉甲湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Late-stage warm disease: night fever with morning coolness, heat receding without sweating, steamy bone fever.
pairs.caution_zh: 感冒發熱、實熱證者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in common cold fever or excess heat patterns.

pairs.name_en: Zhi Mu with Huang Bai
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 知母滋陰潤燥、清肺胃腎之熱；黃柏苦寒瀉火、專清下焦瀉相火。兩藥相須，滋陰降火、清瀉相火之力甚強，為治療陰虛火旺、骨蒸潮熱核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Zhi Mu nourishes yin and clears heat; Huang Bai purges minister fire in the lower jiao. Core pair for Yin deficiency with flaming minister fire.
pairs.indication_zh: 陰虛火旺、骨蒸潮熱、盜汗遺精、小便短赤灼熱（知柏地黃丸證）
pairs.indication_en: Yin deficiency with flaming fire: steamy bone fever, night sweats, nocturnal emission, burning urination.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、便溏食少者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Spleen/Stomach cold deficiency with loose stools.

pairs.name_en: Ren Shen with Fu Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 人參大補元氣、固脫復脈；附子大補命門火、回陽救逆。人參得附子則補氣更速，附子得人參則回陽更固，氣陽雙補、回陽固脫第一藥對（參附湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ren Shen strongly tonifies primordial qi; Fu Zi warms Kidney yang and revives yang. Dual Qi-Yang tonification for severe collapse.
pairs.indication_zh: 大汗大吐大瀉後氣血津液脫失、陽氣暴脫、四肢厥逆、脈微欲絕（參附湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Qi and Yang collapse after severe bleeding/diarrhea: cold limbs, faint pulse, extreme exhaustion (Shen Fu Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 陽證、實熱證昏迷者禁用。
pairs.caution_en: Forbidden in coma due to Yang excess or interior heat.

pairs.name_en: Tao Ren with Hong Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 桃仁破血行瘀、潤燥滑腸；紅花活血通經、祛瘀止痛。桃仁走血分而沉降，紅花走血分而升浮。兩藥相須，活血化瘀之力顯著，為治療全身各處血瘀之核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Tao Ren breaks blood stasis and descends; Hong Hua invigorates blood and ascends. Powerful classic combination for blood stasis anywhere in the body.
pairs.indication_zh: 血瘀證：痛經、經閉、產後惡露不盡、胸痹心痛、跌打損傷、血栓（桃紅四物湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Blood stasis: dysmenorrhea, amenorrhea, chest pain, traumatic injuries, thrombosis.
pairs.caution_zh: 孕婦及出血性疾病者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in pregnancy or active bleeding disorders.

pairs.name_en: Ban Xia with Hou Po
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 半夏燥濕化痰、降逆和胃；厚朴行氣燥濕、下氣除滿。半夏主化痰降逆，厚朴主行氣消脹。兩藥相須，行氣化痰、降逆除滿之力甚強（半夏厚朴湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ban Xia transforms phlegm and lowers rebellious qi; Hou Po moves qi and relieves fullness. Essential pair for phlegm-qi stagnation.
pairs.indication_zh: 梅核氣、氣鬱痰凝證：咽中如有物咯之不出咽之不下、胸悶嘔吐
pairs.indication_en: Globus hystericus (mei he qi): plum-pit sensation in throat, chest fullness, nausea.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛津傷乾咳少痰者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with dry cough.

pairs.name_en: Chen Pi with Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 陳皮理氣健脾、燥濕化痰；半夏燥濕化痰、降逆和胃。陳皮主理氣，半夏主化痰。氣順則痰消，兩藥相須，理氣化痰、燥濕和中之核心藥對（二陳湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chen Pi regulates qi and dries dampness; Ban Xia transforms phlegm and lowers rebellion. Regulating qi resolves phlegm (Er Chen Tang).
pairs.indication_zh: 濕痰咳嗽、脾胃氣滯：咳嗽痰多、色白易咯、胸脘痞悶、噁心嘔吐
pairs.indication_en: Damp-phlegm cough and Stomach qi stagnation: profuse white easy-to-expectorate phlegm, nausea.
pairs.caution_zh: 燥痰、陰虛乾咳少痰者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in dry cough from Yin deficiency.

pairs.indications_en: Damp-phlegm cough and Stomach qi stagnation: profuse white easy-to-expectorate phlegm, nausea.
pairs.cautions_zh: 燥痰、陰虛乾咳少痰者忌用。
pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated in dry cough from Yin deficiency.

pairs.name_en: Ban Xia with Sheng Jiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 半夏燥濕化痰、降逆止嘔；生薑溫中和胃、降逆止嘔，並能制約半夏之毒。兩藥相使，增強化飲降逆、和胃止嘔之力（小半夏湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ban Xia transforms Phlegm and redirects rebellious Qi; Sheng Jiang warms and harmonizes the Stomach, assists the antiemetic action, and moderates Ban Xia toxicity.
pairs.indication_zh: 胃寒痰飲上逆：噁心嘔吐、吐清水痰涎、心下痞悶（小半夏湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Cold Phlegm and thin fluids rebelling from the Stomach: nausea, vomiting of clear fluids and epigastric focal distention.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛燥咳、津傷口渴、血證及痰熱而無適當清熱配伍者忌用；內服須用炮製半夏。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Yin or fluid deficiency, bleeding disorders, or unbalanced Phlegm-Heat; only processed Ban Xia is used internally.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Gui Zhi with Bai Shao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 桂枝辛溫解肌發表、溫通衛陽；白芍酸寒斂陰和營、養血柔肝。桂枝主發散，白芍主主收斂。一散一收，調和營衛、雙向調節發汗與止汗（桂枝湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gui Zhi warms and releases the muscle layer (wei qi); Bai Shao sours and nourishes ying blood. One opens and one restrains, harmonizing Ying and Wei.
pairs.indication_zh: 營衛不和、表虛自汗：發熱惡風、汗出、頭痛、鼻塞（桂枝湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Disharmony of Ying and Wei: chills, fever, spontaneous sweating, headache (Gui Zhi Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 表實無汗、溫病熱盛者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Forbidden in exterior excess without sweating or high fever from warm disease.

pairs.name_en: Gan Jiang with Xi Xin and Wu Wei Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 乾薑溫脾肺以化飲，細辛搜寒飲兼解表，五味子酸收斂肺止咳。一溫一散一收，溫肺化飲而不傷陰，斂肺止咳而不留邪，為溫肺化飲止咳之金三角藥對（小青龍湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gan Jiang warms the Lungs to transform fluids; Xi Xin dispels cold; Wu Wei Zi astringes Lung qi. Warming, dispersing, and astringing combined.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒飲伏肺、咳嗽氣喘、痰多清稀、胸膈痞滿（小青龍湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Cold-fluid in the Lungs: cough, asthma, profuse clear thin phlegm.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛乾咳少痰、肺熱咳血者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in dry cough from Yin deficiency or lung heat hemoptysis.

pairs.name_en: Huang Lian with Huang Qin and Huang Bai
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 黃芩清上焦肺火，黃連清中焦胃火，黃柏瀉下焦腎火。三黃合用，苦寒瀉火，直折三焦火毒，為瀉火解毒第一大藥對（黃連解毒湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huang Qin clears upper jiao; Huang Lian clears middle jiao; Huang Bai purges lower jiao. The three Yellows clear fire from all three jiaos.
pairs.indication_zh: 三焦火毒熾盛：大熱煩躁、口燥咽乾、錯語不眠、吐血衄血、發斑（黃連解毒湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Three jiao fire toxicity: high fever, extreme restlessness, bleeding, delirium.
pairs.caution_zh: 大苦大寒，易傷脾胃，非實熱火毒者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Bitter and cold, damages Spleen/Stomach; forbidden without excess heat.

pairs.name_en: Fu Ling with Bai Zhu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白朮苦溫健脾燥濕，茯苓甘淡健脾利濕。白朮主燥濕，茯苓主利濕。一燥一利，健脾除濕之力大增，為健脾利濕之基礎藥對（四君子湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Zhu dries dampness and tonifies Spleen; Fu Ling leaches out dampness. Core pair for strengthening Spleen and removing dampness.
pairs.indication_zh: 脾虛濕盛：食少便溏、腹脹身重、肢體水腫、痰飲內停
pairs.indication_en: Spleen deficiency with dampness: poor appetite, loose stools, abdominal fullness, edema.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛津傷者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in fluid deficiency or Yin deficiency.
pairs.actions_zh: 白朮苦溫健脾燥濕，茯苓甘淡健脾利濕。白朮主燥濕，茯苓主利濕。一燥一利，健脾除濕之力大增，為健脾利濕之基礎藥對（四君子湯）。
pairs.actions_en: Bai Zhu dries dampness and tonifies Spleen; Fu Ling leaches out dampness. Core pair for strengthening Spleen and removing dampness.
pairs.indications_zh: 脾虛濕盛：食少便溏、腹脹身重、肢體水腫、痰飲內停
pairs.indications_en: Spleen deficiency with dampness: poor appetite, loose stools, abdominal fullness, edema.
pairs.cautions_zh: 陰虛津傷者慎用。
pairs.cautions_en: Caution in fluid deficiency or Yin deficiency.

pairs.name_en: Bai Zhu with Cang Zhu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蒼朮辛溫苦燥、燥濕健脾力強兼解表；白朮苦甘溫、補脾燥濕止汗。蒼朮主燥、白朮主補。一燥一補，燥濕不傷正，補脾不留濕。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Cang Zhu strongly dries dampness; Bai Zhu tonifies Spleen and dries dampness. Drying without injuring qi, tonifying without retaining dampness.
pairs.indication_zh: 脾虛濕阻：脘腹脹滿、不思飲食、肢體沉重、苔白膩
pairs.indication_en: Spleen deficiency with damp retention: epigastric fullness, loss of appetite, greasy tongue coat.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛內熱、津液虧虛者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with internal heat.
pairs.actions_zh: 蒼朮辛溫苦燥、燥濕健脾力強兼解表；白朮苦甘溫、補脾燥濕止汗。蒼朮主燥、白朮主補。一燥一補，燥濕不傷正，補脾不留濕。

pairs.cautions_zh: 陰虛內熱、津液虧虛者忌用。
pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with internal heat.

pairs.name_en: Chuan Xiong with Xi Xin
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 川芎辛溫走頂、活血行氣止頭痛，為血中氣藥；細辛辛溫通竅、搜風止痛，善治少陰及諸經頭痛。兩藥相須，上行頭目、通竅止痛之力甚強。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chuan Xiong ascends to head to relieve headache; Xi Xin dispels wind and stops pain. Powerful combination for headaches.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒頭痛、偏正頭痛、齒痛、鼻塞（川芎茶調散證）
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Cold headache, migraine, toothache, nasal congestion.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、肝陽上亢頭痛者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in headache from Liver Yang hyperactivity or Yin deficiency.

pairs.name_en: Shan Zha with Shen Qu and Mai Ya
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 山楂善消肉食油膩積滯，神曲善消穀食金石積滯，麥芽善消麵食米麵積滯。三藥合用（焦三仙），消食化積無所不包，為消食導滯核心藥對（保和丸）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shan Zha digests meat and fats; Shen Qu digests grains; Mai Ya digests starches (Jiao San Xian). Complete digestive assistance.
pairs.indication_zh: 飲食積滯：脘腹脹滿、噯腐吞酸、不思飲食、大便臭穢（保和丸證）
pairs.indication_en: Food stagnation: abdominal fullness, belching with foul odor, acid regurgitation (Bao He Wan pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛弱無積滯者不宜多服；麥芽有回乳作用，哺乳期婦女慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in lactation as Mai Ya inhibits lactation.

pairs.name_en: Suan Zao Ren with Zhi Mu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 酸棗仁甘平養肝血、寧心安神；知母苦寒清熱滋陰、降火除煩。酸棗仁主補陰血，知母主清虛熱。一補一清，安神除煩之力甚強（酸棗仁湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Suan Zao Ren nourishes Liver blood and calms spirit; Zhi Mu clears deficiency heat. Tonifying and clearing combined for insomnia.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝血不足、陰虛內熱：虛煩不寐、驚悸不安、頭目眩暈、手足心熱（酸棗仁湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Liver blood deficiency with deficiency heat: insomnia from irritability, palpitations, dizziness.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾虛便溏者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in Spleen deficiency with loose stools.

pairs.name_en: Tian Ma with Gou Teng
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 天麻甘平息風止痙、平肝潛陽；鉤藤甘微寒清熱平肝、息風止痙。兩藥相須，平肝熄風、清熱止眩之力大增，為平肝熄風第一藥對（天麻鉤藤飲）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Tian Ma extinguishes wind and anchors yang; Gou Teng clears heat and quells wind. Classic pair for Liver wind and vertigo.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝陽上亢、肝風內動：頭痛眩暈、耳鳴、半身麻木、肢體震顫（天麻鉤藤飲證）
pairs.indication_en: Liver Yang hyperactivity & internal wind: headache, vertigo, tinnitus, tremors (Tian Ma Gou Teng Yin pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 津傷血虛無風者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in blood deficiency without wind.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ren Shen with Huang Qi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 人參大補元氣、補五髒之氣；黃芪大補脾肺之氣、升陽舉陷、固表止汗。人參補內，黃芪固外。兩藥相須，大補氣血、升陽固表之力極強（補中益氣湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ren Shen tonifies interior primordial qi; Huang Qi tonifies exterior wei qi and raises sunken qi. Comprehensive qi tonification.
pairs.indication_zh: 脾肺氣虛、中氣下陷：少氣懶言、體倦乏力、久瀉脫肛、子宮脫垂（補中益氣湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Spleen/Lung qi deficiency & qi sinking: shortness of breath, fatigue, organ prolapse.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、實熱邪盛者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in excess heat or Yin deficiency with flaming fire.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Shu Di Huang with Shan Zhu Yu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 熟地甘溫大補腎陰、填精益髓；山茱萸酸溫收斂固澀、補肝腎固精氣。熟地主填精，山茱萸主收澀。一補一澀，封填腎精而不洩，為滋補肝腎之核心藥對（六味地黃丸）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shu Di Huang heavily replenishes Kidney essence; Shan Zhu Yu astringes essence. Nourishing and astringing essence together.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝腎陰虛、精血虧虛：腰膝酸軟、頭暈耳鳴、遺精盜汗、骨蒸潮熱（六味地黃丸證）
pairs.indication_en: Liver/Kidney Yin deficiency: sore knees, tinnitus, nocturnal emission, steamy bone fever.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾虛便溏、濕熱內蘊者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Spleen deficiency with loose stools or internal damp-heat.

pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated in Spleen deficiency with loose stools or internal damp-heat.

pairs.name_en: Zhi Shi with Hou Po
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 枳實破氣消積、化痰除痞，主下氣破積；厚朴行氣燥濕、下氣除滿，主消除腹脹。兩藥相須，行氣導滯、破氣消積之力極強，為通腑瀉下核心藥對（大承氣湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Zhi Shi breaks stagnant qi and purges accumulation; Hou Po relieves abdominal fullness. Powerful pair for purging gastrointestinal accumulation.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸胃積滯、燥屎內結：脘腹脹滿、疼痛拒按、大便秘結（大承氣湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Gastrointestinal food stagnation & constipation: severe abdominal pain, distension, constipation (Da Cheng Qi Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 孕婦及脾胃虛弱者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in pregnancy or severe Spleen deficiency.

pairs.name_en: Chuan Xiong with Dang Gui and Chi Shao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 當歸養血和血，川芎行氣活血，赤芍清熱涼血化瘀。三藥合用，養血活血、涼血散瘀，為治經產血瘀痛經之要藥。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dang Gui nourishes blood; Chuan Xiong moves qi; Chi Shao clears heat and transforms stasis. Invigorates blood without drying.
pairs.indication_zh: 婦科血瘀、痛經經閉、產後惡露不盡、跌打損傷
pairs.indication_en: Gynecological blood stasis, dysmenorrhea, postpartum lochia, traumatic injuries.
pairs.caution_zh: 月經過多者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in menorrhagia.

pairs.name_en: Sang Ye with Ju Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 桑葉清宣肺熱、疏散風熱；菊花清肝明目、疏散風熱。桑葉主肺，菊花主肝，兩藥相須，清宣風熱、清肝明目之力增強（桑菊飲）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Sang Ye clears and vents Lung Heat while Ju Hua clears the Liver and brightens the eyes. Together they mutually reinforce Wind-Heat release and Liver-eye clearing, as in Sang Ju Yin.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱感冒、溫病初起：發熱頭痛、咳嗽、目赤腫痛、頭暈（桑菊飲證）
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat common cold or early warm disease: fever, headache, cough, red painful eyes, and dizziness.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥皆偏寒涼；脾胃虛寒、肺虛寒或氣虛者慎用，並依各單味安全欄辨證。
pairs.caution_en: Both herbs are cool/cold; use caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, weak/cold Lung, or Qi deficiency, and consult each single-herb safety panel.

pairs.name_en: Huang Qi with Fang Feng
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 黃芪甘溫大補脾肺之氣、固表止汗；防風辛溫祛風解表勝濕。黃芪得防風則固表而不留邪，防風得黃芪則祛風而不傷正。補散兼施，固表禦風第一藥對（玉屏風散）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huang Qi tonifies wei qi to stabilize exterior; Fang Feng dispels wind. Huang Qi prevents exterior pathogens; Fang Feng expels lingering wind.
pairs.indication_zh: 表虛自汗、體虛易感風邪：惡風自汗、面色皎白、易感冒（玉屏風散證）
pairs.indication_en: Exterior deficiency spontaneous sweating & susceptibility to cold: aversion to wind, pale complexion, frequent colds.
pairs.caution_zh: 外感風寒表實無汗者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in exterior excess Wind-Cold without sweating.

pairs.name_en: Long Gu with Mu Li
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 龍骨甘澀平鎮心安神、收斂固澀；牡蠣咸澀微寒平肝潛陽、軟堅散結、收斂固澀。兩藥相須，鎮靜安神、平肝潛陽、收斂固澀之力極強（桂枝加龍骨牡蠣湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Long Gu calms spirit and astringes essence; Mu Li anchors Liver yang and softens hardness. Combined for anxiety, palpitations, and fluid loss.
pairs.indication_zh: 心神不安、陰虛陽亢、自汗盜汗、遺精帶下、驚悸失眠
pairs.indication_en: Emotional restlessness, Liver Yang hyperactivity, spontaneous/night sweats, nocturnal emission, insomnia.
pairs.caution_zh: 有濕熱積滯者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in damp-heat or food accumulation.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17
pairs.actions_zh: 龍骨甘澀平鎮心安神、收斂固澀；牡蠣咸澀微寒平肝潛陽、軟堅散結、收斂固澀。兩藥相須，鎮靜安神、平肝潛陽、收斂固澀之力極強（桂枝加龍骨牡蠣湯）。
pairs.actions_en: Long Gu calms spirit and astringes essence; Mu Li anchors Liver yang and softens hardness. Combined for anxiety, palpitations, and fluid loss.
pairs.indications_zh: 心神不安、陰虛陽亢、自汗盜汗、遺精帶下、驚悸失眠
pairs.indications_en: Emotional restlessness, Liver Yang hyperactivity, spontaneous/night sweats, nocturnal emission, insomnia.
pairs.cautions_zh: 有濕熱積滯者忌用。
pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated in damp-heat or food accumulation.

pairs.name_en: Ju He with Chuan Lian Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 橘核苦平行氣散結、止痛；川楝子苦寒行氣疏肝、清熱止痛。兩藥相須，疏肝理氣、行氣止痛、散結消腫之力顯著，為治療疝氣睪丸腫痛第一藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ju He moves qi and dissipates nodules; Chuan Lian Zi clears heat and relieves pain. Core pair for testicular pain and hernia.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒疝腹痛、睪丸腫痛、偏墜腫脹、乳房脹痛
pairs.indication_en: Cold hernia pain, testicular swelling and pain, breast distension pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 川楝子有小毒，用量不宜過大。`herb.ju_he` 尚未建卡，之後補卡會自動恢復連結。
pairs.caution_en: Chuan Lian Zi is slightly toxic; control dosage carefully. `herb.ju_he` is pending local card creation.

pairs.name_en: Xian Mao with Yin Yang Huo
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 仙茅辛熱補腎壯陽、祛寒除濕；淫羊藿辛甘溫補腎壯陽、祛風除濕。兩藥相須，溫補命門、壯陽祛濕之力甚強，為治療腎陽虛衰核心藥對（二仙湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Xian Mao strongly warms Kidney yang; Yin Yang Huo warms yang and dispels wind-damp. Essential combination for Kidney Yang deficiency.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽虛衰、命門火衰：陽痿不育、腰膝冷痛、高血壓更年期綜合徵（二仙湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency: impotence, cold knees, menopausal hypertension (Er Xian Tang pattern).
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency with flaming fire.

pairs.name_en: Xian Mao with Du Zhong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 仙茅辛熱有毒，強補腎陽、祛寒濕；杜仲甘溫補肝腎、強筋骨。兩藥相使，仙茅溫腎逐寒，杜仲扶肝腎筋骨，使下焦陽虛兼腰膝冷痛者補而能行。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Xian Mao strongly warms Kidney Yang and dispels Cold-Damp; Du Zhong tonifies Liver/Kidney and strengthens bones and sinews. Together they support Kidney Yang deficiency with low-back and leg weakness.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽虛衰兼腰膝冷痛、筋骨痿軟、陽痿遺精；AD 列 impotence, spermatorrhea, weakness and pain in lower back and legs。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency with low-back/knee cold pain, weak bones and sinews, impotence, and spermatorrhea; listed in American Dragon combinations.
pairs.caution_zh: 仙茅辛熱有毒，陰虛火旺、實熱、孕期禁用；不可久服。
pairs.caution_en: Xian Mao is hot and toxic; contraindicated in Yin deficiency heat, Excess Heat, pregnancy, and long-term use.

pairs.name_zh: 白花蛇舌草配敗醬草、金銀花
pairs.name_en: Bai Hua She She Cao with Bai Jiang Cao and Jin Yin Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白花蛇舌草清熱解毒、消癰散結；敗醬草清熱解毒、排膿消癰；金銀花清熱解毒、疏散熱毒。三藥相使，強化腸癰與熱毒癰腫之清解排膿力。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Hua She She Cao clears Heat-toxicity and reduces abscesses; Bai Jiang Cao clears toxicity and expels pus; Jin Yin Hua vents and resolves Heat-toxicity. Together they strengthen treatment of intestinal abscess and toxic swellings.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸癰、闌尾炎樣右下腹痛、熱毒腹癰；課件原組合另列紅藤，但本地尚未建紅藤卡，本筆先以已存在卡片建立。
pairs.indication_en: Intestinal abscess / appendicitis-like right-lower-quadrant heat-toxin abscess; the course also lists Hong Teng, but the local Hong Teng card is not yet present.
pairs.caution_zh: 白花蛇舌草性寒，脾胃虛寒、孕期/哺乳期與腎病患者慎用；若急腹症疑似闌尾炎不可延誤急診評估。
pairs.caution_en: Bai Hua She She Cao is cold; use caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, pregnancy/lactation, and kidney disease. Suspected acute appendicitis requires urgent medical evaluation.
pairs.actions_zh: 白花蛇舌草清熱解毒、消癰散結；敗醬草清熱解毒、排膿消癰；金銀花清熱解毒、疏散熱毒。三藥相使，強化腸癰與熱毒癰腫之清解排膿力。

pairs.cautions_en: Bai Hua She She Cao is cold; use caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, pregnancy/lactation, and kidney disease. Suspected acute appendicitis requires urgent medical evaluation.

pairs.name_zh: 白花蛇舌草配茵陳蒿、黃柏、梔子
pairs.name_en: Bai Hua She She Cao with Yin Chen Hao, Huang Bai, and Zhi Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白花蛇舌草清熱解毒並利濕；茵陳蒿清利濕熱退黃；黃柏清下焦濕熱；梔子清三焦火熱並利濕。合用清熱解毒、利濕退黃之力較完整。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Hua She She Cao clears toxicity and promotes urination; Yin Chen Hao clears Damp-Heat jaundice; Huang Bai drains lower-jiao Damp-Heat; Zhi Zi clears Heat through the Triple Burner. Together they clear Heat-toxicity and Damp-Heat jaundice.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱黃疸、肝膽濕熱、小便黃赤；AD major combinations 列此組。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat jaundice, hepatobiliary Damp-Heat, and dark scanty urine; listed in American Dragon major combinations.
pairs.caution_zh: 苦寒清利藥較多，脾胃虛寒、便溏、孕期與腎病患者需慎用並核對病機。
pairs.caution_en: This is a cold bitter draining combination; use caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, loose stools, pregnancy, and kidney disease.
pairs.actions_zh: 白花蛇舌草清熱解毒並利濕；茵陳蒿清利濕熱退黃；黃柏清下焦濕熱；梔子清三焦火熱並利濕。合用清熱解毒、利濕退黃之力較完整。

pairs.name_zh: 白鮮皮配黃柏、苦參、防風
pairs.name_en: Bai Xian Pi with Huang Bai, Ku Shen, and Fang Feng
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白鮮皮清熱燥濕、祛風止癢；黃柏清下焦濕熱；苦參苦寒燥濕殺蟲止癢；防風祛風止癢。合用針對濕熱兼風之皮膚瘙癢、滲液與瘡毒。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Xian Pi clears Damp-Heat and stops itching; Huang Bai drains lower-jiao Damp-Heat; Ku Shen dries Dampness and stops itching; Fang Feng dispels Wind and relieves itching. Together they address Damp-Heat with Wind in itchy, oozing skin disease.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱瘡毒、濕疹、風疹、瘙癢、滲液潰瘍；課件 review question 明列 Huang Bai, Ku Shen, Fang Feng 可配白鮮皮治多種皮膚病。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat toxic sores, eczema, rashes, itching, and oozing ulcerations; the course explicitly lists Huang Bai, Ku Shen, and Fang Feng with Bai Xian Pi for many skin conditions.
pairs.caution_zh: 白鮮皮孕期禁用；虛寒、脾虛便溏、肝病/肝功能差者慎用或禁用；需核對 AD 所列化療藥交互。
pairs.caution_en: Bai Xian Pi is contraindicated during pregnancy; avoid or use cautiously in deficiency-cold, loose stools, liver disease/poor liver function, and check American Dragon drug interactions.

pairs.name_en: Bai Xian Pi with Da Huang and Zhi Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白鮮皮清濕熱、解毒止癢；大黃瀉熱通腑、涼血解毒；梔子清熱瀉火、利濕。合用可加強濕熱黃疸、熱毒內結之清泄力。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Xian Pi clears Damp-Heat and toxicity; Da Huang drains Heat through the bowels and cools Blood; Zhi Zi clears Heat and promotes Damp-Heat drainage. Together they strengthen clearing and draining in Damp-Heat jaundice.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱黃疸；AD major combinations 列白鮮皮配大黃、梔子。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat jaundice; listed in American Dragon major combinations.
pairs.caution_zh: 大黃攻下，孕期、虛寒、便溏、體虛者需嚴格辨證；白鮮皮另有孕禁與肝功能/藥物交互注意。
pairs.caution_en: Da Huang is purgative; pregnancy, deficiency-cold, loose stools, and frailty require strict differentiation. Bai Xian Pi adds pregnancy, liver-function, and drug-interaction cautions.

pairs.name_en: Ba Ji Tian with Rou Cong Rong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 巴戟天辛甘溫補腎陽、強筋骨、祛風濕；肉蓯蓉甘鹹溫補腎陽、益精血、潤腸通便。巴戟天主溫補強筋，肉蓯蓉主溫潤通便。溫而不燥，補而不滯。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ba Ji Tian warms Kidney yang and strengthens bones; Rou Cong Rong tonifies essence and moistens intestines. Warming without drying.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽虛衰、精血不足：陽痿早洩、腰膝酸軟、宮冷不孕、腸燥便秘
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency & essence depletion: impotence, cold uterus infertility, constipation from dryness.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、大便溏薄者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency fire or loose stools.

pairs.name_en: Mai Men Dong with Wu Wei Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麥門冬甘微苦微寒滋陰潤肺、益胃生津；五味子酸溫酸收斂肺止汗、生津止渴。麥門冬主滋潤，五味子主收斂。一滋一斂，生津止渴、斂肺止汗（生脈散）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Mai Men Dong nourishes Yin and Lungs; Wu Wei Zi astringes Lung qi and sweat. Nourishing and astringing combined (Sheng Mai San).
pairs.indication_zh: 暑熱耗氣傷陰、肺腎陰虛：乾咳少痰、口乾舌燥、汗多肢倦、脈虛數（生脈散證）
pairs.indication_en: Summerheat damaging Qi & Yin: dry cough, extreme thirst, excessive sweating, rapid weak pulse.
pairs.caution_zh: 外感暴咳、實熱證者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in acute exterior cold cough or excess heat.
pairs.actions_zh: 麥門冬甘微苦微寒滋陰潤肺、益胃生津；五味子酸溫酸收斂肺止汗、生津止渴。麥門冬主滋潤，五味子主收斂。一滋一斂，生津止渴、斂肺止汗（生脈散）。

pairs.indications_en: Summerheat damaging Qi & Yin: dry cough, extreme thirst, excessive sweating, rapid weak pulse.
pairs.cautions_zh: 外感暴咳、實熱證者忌用。
pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated in acute exterior cold cough or excess heat.

pairs.name_en: Ren Shen with Mai Dong and Wu Wei Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 人參大補元氣，麥冬滋陰潤肺生津，五味子斂肺止汗生津。三藥合用（生脈散），氣陰雙補、固脫復脈，為暑熱傷氣傷陰復脈救逆之第一金三角。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ren Shen tonifies qi; Mai Dong generates fluids; Wu Wei Zi astringes sweat (Sheng Mai San). Core trio for Qi-Yin depletion.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣陰兩傷、肢體倦怠、氣短懶言、口乾作渴、汗多脈虛（生脈散）
pairs.indication_en: Dual Qi-Yin deficiency: severe fatigue, shortness of breath, profuse sweating, thirst.
pairs.caution_zh: 外感風寒未解者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated while exterior Wind-Cold is uncleared.
pairs.actions_zh: 人參大補元氣，麥冬滋陰潤肺生津，五味子斂肺止汗生津。三藥合用（生脈散），氣陰雙補、固脫復脈，為暑熱傷氣傷陰復脈救逆之第一金三角。
pairs.actions_en: Ren Shen tonifies qi; Mai Dong generates fluids; Wu Wei Zi astringes sweat (Sheng Mai San). Core trio for Qi-Yin depletion.
pairs.indications_zh: 氣陰兩傷、肢體倦怠、氣短懶言、口乾作渴、汗多脈虛（生脈散）
pairs.indications_en: Dual Qi-Yin deficiency: severe fatigue, shortness of breath, profuse sweating, thirst.
pairs.cautions_zh: 外感風寒未解者忌用。
pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated while exterior Wind-Cold is uncleared.

pairs.name_en: Tian Nan Xing with Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 天南星燥濕化痰、祛風止痙，長於頑痰與風痰；半夏燥濕化痰、降逆和胃，長於濕痰與胃氣上逆。兩藥相須，燥濕化痰之力增強，並兼顧痰壅、氣逆。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Tian Nan Xing treats stubborn and Wind-Phlegm; Ban Xia dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and descends rebellious Qi. Together they strongly transform Damp-Phlegm.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕痰、頑痰壅盛：咳嗽痰多黏稠、胸膈痞悶、眩暈噁心。
pairs.indication_en: Abundant Damp or stubborn Phlegm with cough, copious sputum, chest oppression, dizziness and nausea.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥均溫燥有毒，內服必須用炮製品；陰虛燥痰、孕婦禁用，痰熱證須配清熱藥。
pairs.caution_en: Both herbs are warm, drying and toxic; use only processed forms internally. Contraindicated in pregnancy and Yin-deficient Dry Phlegm.

pairs.name_en: Bai Fu Zi with Bai Jiang Can and Quan Xie
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白附子祛頭面風痰、止痙；白僵蠶與全蠍息風止痙、通絡。三藥相須，祛風化痰、止痙通絡，構成牽正散核心配伍。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Fu Zi dispels Wind-Phlegm from the head and face; Bai Jiang Can and Quan Xie extinguish Wind and unblock the channels. This is the core trio of Qian Zheng San.
pairs.indication_zh: 風痰阻絡：口眼歪斜、面肌抽動、面癱，或痙攣拘急。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Phlegm obstructing the channels with facial paralysis, facial twitching or spasms.
pairs.caution_zh: 三藥均須嚴格控量；白附子有毒，孕婦禁用；全蠍有毒，出血傾向者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Dose carefully. Bai Fu Zi is toxic and contraindicated in pregnancy; use Quan Xie cautiously with bleeding tendency.

pairs.name_zh: 白芥子配紫蘇子、萊菔子
pairs.name_en: Bai Jie Zi with Zi Su Zi and Lai Fu Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白芥子溫肺豁痰，紫蘇子降氣化痰平喘，萊菔子消食導滯、降氣化痰。三藥相須，痰、氣、食並治，為三子養親湯核心。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Jie Zi warms the Lung and expels Phlegm, Zi Su Zi descends Qi and calms wheezing, and Lai Fu Zi reduces food stagnation. The trio treats Phlegm, Qi rebellion and food stagnation together.
pairs.indication_zh: 痰壅氣逆兼食積：咳嗽喘逆、痰多胸悶、食少腹脹。
pairs.indication_en: Phlegm with rebellious Qi and food stagnation: cough, wheezing, copious sputum, chest oppression and abdominal distention.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛燥咳、肺虛久咳者忌；氣虛無痰、無食積者不宜。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Yin-deficient dry cough or chronic Lung-deficiency cough; inappropriate for Qi deficiency without Phlegm or food stagnation.

pairs.cautions_en: Avoid in Yin-deficient dry cough or chronic Lung-deficiency cough; inappropriate for Qi deficiency without Phlegm or food stagnation.

pairs.name_en: Jie Geng with Gan Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 桔梗宣肺利咽、祛痰排膿；甘草清熱解毒、緩急利咽並調和藥性。桔梗為主、甘草為輔，相使而增強利咽止痛與排膿作用。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jie Geng disseminates Lung Qi, benefits the throat and expels pus; Gan Cao assists by clearing toxicity, soothing pain and harmonizing the combination.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺氣不宣或熱毒咽痛：咽喉腫痛、聲音嘶啞；亦用於肺癰咳吐膿痰（桔梗湯）。
pairs.indication_en: Sore, swollen throat and hoarseness from constrained Lung Qi or toxicity; also Lung abscess with purulent sputum.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛乾咳、咳血者慎用桔梗；甘草不宜長期大量使用，水腫、高血壓者注意。
pairs.caution_en: Use Jie Geng cautiously with Yin-deficient dry cough or hemoptysis. Avoid prolonged high-dose Gan Cao in edema or hypertension.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Xuan Fu Hua with Dai Zhe Shi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 旋覆花消痰降氣、降逆止嘔；代赭石重鎮降逆。旋覆花為主、代赭石為輔，相使以加強降胃氣、止噫氣嘔吐，為旋覆代赭湯核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Xuan Fu Hua transforms Phlegm and descends rebellious Qi; Dai Zhe Shi heavily anchors rebellion downward. Together they strongly descend Stomach Qi.
pairs.indication_zh: 胃虛痰阻、胃氣上逆：心下痞硬、噫氣頻作、呃逆、噁心嘔吐。
pairs.indication_en: Stomach deficiency with Phlegm and rebellious Qi: focal epigastric distention, frequent belching, hiccups, nausea and vomiting.
pairs.caution_zh: 旋覆花須包煎；代赭石質重，孕婦慎用，脾胃虛弱者不宜過量。
pairs.caution_en: Wrap Xuan Fu Hua for decoction. Use heavy Dai Zhe Shi cautiously in pregnancy and avoid excessive doses in weak digestion.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Ren Shen
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃發汗散寒、宣肺解表；人參益氣扶正，防止體虛者發汗更傷正氣。麻黃為主、人參為輔，相使以達扶正解表。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang releases Wind-Cold through sweating, while Ren Shen supports source Qi and limits further depletion in a deficient patient.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣虛外感風寒：惡寒、無汗、頭痛身痛兼氣短乏力、脈弱。
pairs.indication_en: Exterior Wind-Cold with Qi deficiency: chills, no sweating and body aches with fatigue, shortness of breath and a weak pulse.
pairs.caution_zh: 表虛自汗、陰虛盜汗者仍不宜使用麻黃；不可因配人參而忽略心血管與交互作用風險。
pairs.caution_en: Still unsuitable for spontaneous or night sweating; adding Ren Shen does not remove Ma Huang's cardiovascular or interaction risks.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Fu Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃發汗解表、宣肺行水；附子溫陽扶正、助陽散寒。兩藥相使，使外寒得解而不致更傷衰微之陽氣。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang releases the exterior and mobilizes water; Fu Zi restores Yang and assists the dispersal of Cold.
pairs.indication_zh: 陽虛外感或陽虛水腫：畏寒甚、無汗、肢冷、神疲、脈沉微。
pairs.indication_en: Exterior Cold or edema with Yang deficiency: marked aversion to cold, no sweating, cold limbs, fatigue and a deep faint pulse.
pairs.caution_zh: 附子有毒，必須使用合格炮製品並遵守劑量與煎煮規範；陰虛火旺及心律不整者不宜。
pairs.caution_en: Fu Zi is toxic and requires proper processing, dosing and decoction; avoid in Yin-deficiency Heat and arrhythmia.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Gan Jiang, Xi Xin and Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃解表宣肺，乾薑、細辛溫肺化飲，半夏燥濕化痰、降逆。合用由表及裡溫散寒飲，相須增強止咳平喘之力。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang releases the exterior; Gan Jiang and Xi Xin warm the Lung and transform thin fluids; Ban Xia dries Phlegm and redirects rebellion.
pairs.indication_zh: 外寒內飲：惡寒發熱、無汗、咳喘、痰多清稀、胸滿或乾嘔（小青龍湯核心組合）。
pairs.indication_en: Exterior Cold with internal thin fluids: chills, fever, no sweating, cough, wheezing, copious clear sputum, chest fullness or retching.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛燥咳、津傷、血證及無寒飲者不宜；細辛與半夏均須符合炮製及劑量規範。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Yin-deficient dry cough, fluid injury, bleeding or absence of Cold fluids; observe processing and dose requirements for Xi Xin and Ban Xia.

pairs.cautions_en: Avoid in Yin-deficient dry cough, fluid injury, bleeding or absence of Cold fluids; observe processing and dose requirements for Xi Xin and Ban Xia.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Yi Yi Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃散表寒、通腠理，薏苡仁滲濕舒筋。麻黃為主散寒，薏苡仁為輔利濕，相使以祛風寒濕痹。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang disperses exterior Cold and opens the interstices; Yi Yi Ren leaches Dampness and relaxes the sinews.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒濕痹偏表：周身疼痛、關節沉重，或一身盡疼、午後加重。
pairs.indication_en: Superficial Wind-Cold-Damp painful obstruction with generalized aching and heavy joints.
pairs.caution_zh: 津液不足、陰虛或自汗者慎；孕期使用薏苡仁亦須專業評估。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously with fluid or Yin deficiency and spontaneous sweating; Yi Yi Ren also requires pregnancy review.

pairs.name_zh: 麻黃配熟地黃、白芥子、鹿角膠
pairs.name_en: Ma Huang with Shu Di Huang, Bai Jie Zi and Lu Jiao Jiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃開腠散寒，白芥子溫化寒痰、通絡散結，熟地黃與鹿角膠溫補精血。散寒通滯而兼顧陰血，合治陰寒凝聚。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang opens the interstices, Bai Jie Zi warms Cold Phlegm and disperses nodules, while Shu Di Huang and Lu Jiao Jiao support essence and Blood.
pairs.indication_zh: 陽虛寒凝之陰疽、貼骨疽或漫腫無頭：局部不紅不熱、皮色不變、酸痛無力（陽和湯核心配伍）。
pairs.indication_en: Yin-type sores from Yang deficiency and congealed Cold: diffuse deep swelling without redness, heat or a distinct head.
pairs.caution_zh: 陽證癰瘍、紅腫熱痛或陰虛火旺者禁用；麻黃心血管風險仍須評估。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated for hot Yang-type abscesses or Yin-deficiency Fire; Ma Huang cardiovascular risks still require assessment.
pairs.actions_zh: 麻黃開腠散寒，白芥子溫化寒痰、通絡散結，熟地黃與鹿角膠溫補精血。散寒通滯而兼顧陰血，合治陰寒凝聚。

pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated for hot Yang-type abscesses or Yin-deficiency Fire; Ma Huang cardiovascular risks still require assessment.

pairs.name_en: Bo He with Chai Hu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 柴胡疏肝解鬱；薄荷辛涼輕清，助其疏達肝氣。兩藥相使。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chai Hu courses Liver Qi while Bo He assists its light dispersing movement.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝鬱血虛之胸脅脹痛、情志不舒、月經不調（逍遙散證）
pairs.indication_en: Liver constraint with Blood deficiency: hypochondriac distention, emotional constraint, and menstrual irregularity.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛陽亢或氣逆者須辨證使用。
pairs.caution_en: Use only after pattern differentiation in Yin deficiency with Yang rising or rebellious Qi.

pairs.name_en: Bo He with Chan Tui
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 薄荷疏散風熱、清利咽喉；蟬蛻利咽開音、透疹止癢，兩藥相須。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bo He disperses Wind-Heat and benefits the throat; Chan Tui restores the voice and vents rashes.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱咽痛、聲音嘶啞、麻疹不透或風疹瘙癢
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat sore throat, hoarseness, incomplete measles eruption, or itchy wind rash.
pairs.caution_zh: 表虛多汗及對昆蟲來源藥材過敏者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously with exterior deficiency sweating or allergy to insect-derived medicines.

pairs.name_en: Chan Tui with Pang Da Hai
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蟬蛻疏風熱、利咽開音；胖大海清肺利咽，兩藥相須。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chan Tui dispels Wind-Heat and restores the voice; Pang Da Hai clears the Lung and benefits the throat.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱或肺熱所致咽喉腫痛、聲音嘶啞、失音
pairs.indication_en: Sore swollen throat, hoarseness, or loss of voice from Wind-Heat or Lung Heat.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、便溏者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously with Spleen-Stomach deficiency cold or loose stools.

pairs.name_en: Sang Ye with Xing Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 桑葉清肺潤燥；杏仁降肺氣止咳，一清一降，兩藥相使。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Sang Ye clears and moistens the Lung while Xing Ren directs Lung Qi downward to stop cough.
pairs.indication_zh: 外感溫燥傷肺：乾咳少痰、咽乾口渴、頭痛身熱（桑杏湯證）
pairs.indication_en: Warm-Dryness injuring the Lung: dry cough with scant sputum, dry throat, thirst, headache, and fever.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒便溏者慎用；杏仁劑量須遵專業來源。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously with Spleen-Stomach deficiency cold and loose stools; Xing Ren dosing must follow professional sources.
pairs.actions_zh: 桑葉清肺潤燥；杏仁降肺氣止咳，一清一降，兩藥相使。

pairs.name_en: Gou Qi Zi with Ju Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 枸杞子滋補肝腎、益精明目；菊花清肝明目、平肝。兩藥相使，一補一清，用於肝腎不足或肝陽偏亢所致目疾與頭暈（杞菊地黃丸方向）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gou Qi Zi nourishes Liver and Kidney essence and benefits the eyes, while Ju Hua clears the Liver, brightens the eyes, and calms the Liver. The pair combines supplementation with clearing for eye disorders and dizziness.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝腎不足或肝陰不足之視物昏花、目乾、目澀，兼肝陽上亢頭暈頭痛者。
pairs.indication_en: Blurred, dry, or strained eyes from Liver/Kidney deficiency or Liver Yin deficiency, especially with Liver Yang dizziness or headache.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、便溏或陽虛寒證者慎用菊花；痰濕重或外邪未解時補益藥需辨證。
pairs.caution_en: Use Ju Hua cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, loose stool, or Yang-deficient Cold; use the tonic component cautiously when Damp-Phlegm is heavy or exterior pathogens remain unresolved.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ge Gen with Sheng Ma
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 葛根解肌透疹、生津升陽；升麻升散透疹、升舉清陽。兩藥相使，增強透疹與升清陽之力，常見於升麻葛根湯方向。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ge Gen releases the muscle layer, vents rashes, generates fluids, and raises Yang; Sheng Ma vents rashes and raises clear Yang. Together they assist each other in venting measles and raising clear Yang.
pairs.indication_zh: 麻疹初起透發不暢；熱利下痢或清陽不升所致泄瀉，須依熱象與脾胃狀態配伍。
pairs.indication_en: Incomplete early measles eruption; Heat diarrhea/dysentery or diarrhea from failure of clear Yang to ascend, with formula context adjusted to Heat signs and Spleen/Stomach status.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥升散；陰虛陽亢、汗出過多、氣逆上衝或胃寒汗出者須慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Both herbs are ascending and dispersing; use caution in Yin deficiency with Yang rising, excessive sweating, upward-rebellious Qi, or Stomach Cold with sweating.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Chai Hu with Huang Qin
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 柴胡和解少陽、透達半表半裡；黃芩清少陽膽熱。兩藥相使，外和少陽、內清鬱熱，是小柴胡湯處理少陽寒熱往來的核心藥對。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chai Hu harmonizes Shaoyang and opens the half-exterior/half-interior pivot; Huang Qin clears Shaoyang/Gallbladder Heat. Together they assist each other in harmonizing Shaoyang while clearing constrained Heat.
pairs.indication_zh: 少陽證寒熱往來、胸脅苦滿、口苦、心煩、嘔吐；小柴胡湯方向。
pairs.indication_en: Shaoyang pattern with alternating chills and fever, hypochondriac fullness, bitter taste, irritability, and vomiting; Xiao Chai Hu Tang direction.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛津虧、肝陽上亢或脾胃虛寒者須辨證；黃芩苦寒與柴胡升散方向都不可機械套用。
pairs.caution_en: Use pattern differentiation in Yin/Fluid deficiency, Liver Yang rising, or Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold; do not apply Huang Qin’s bitter-cold clearing or Chai Hu’s ascending-dispersing direction mechanically.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Chai Hu with Sheng Ma
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 柴胡升舉少陽清氣，升麻升舉陽明清陽。兩藥相使，合用增強升提中氣、舉陷之力，常見於補中益氣湯方向。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chai Hu raises the clear Qi of Shaoyang while Sheng Ma raises Yangming clear Yang. Together they assist each other in lifting sinking middle Qi, as in the Bu Zhong Yi Qi Tang direction.
pairs.indication_zh: 中氣下陷、清陽不升：久瀉、脫肛、子宮下垂、胃下垂、疲倦氣短；須配補氣藥使用。
pairs.indication_en: Sinking middle Qi and failure of clear Yang to ascend: chronic diarrhea, rectal or uterine prolapse, stomach prolapse, fatigue, and shortness of breath; use with Qi-tonifying herbs.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛陽亢、肝火上炎、氣逆上衝或實熱上擾者慎用/禁用升散方向。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use caution with this ascending-dispersing strategy in Yin deficiency with Yang rising, Liver Fire flaring upward, upward-rebellious Qi, or excess Heat disturbing upward.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Zhi Zi with Dan Dou Chi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 梔子清泄胸膈鬱熱、除煩；淡豆豉輕宣透邪、宣鬱除煩。兩藥相使，一清一宣，用於熱擾胸膈、煩躁懊憹、不得眠（梔子豉湯方向）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Zhi Zi clears constrained Heat from the chest and diaphragm and relieves vexation; Dan Dou Chi lightly vents pathogens, disperses constraint, and relieves irritability. Together they clear and vent Heat disturbing the chest with vexation and insomnia.
pairs.indication_zh: 熱病後餘熱擾胸膈：心煩懊憹、煩躁不眠、胸中窒悶。
pairs.indication_en: Residual Heat disturbing the chest and diaphragm after febrile disease: vexation, irritability, insomnia, and stifling chest oppression.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、陰寒內盛或哺乳期需慎用淡豆豉；苦寒清泄與輕宣透邪須依寒熱虛實辨證。
pairs.caution_en: Use Dan Dou Chi cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, internal Yin-Cold, or lactation; bitter-cold clearing and light venting require pattern differentiation.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Niu Bang Zi with Lian Qiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 牛蒡子疏散風熱、利咽、透疹並解毒消腫；連翹清熱解毒、散結消腫。兩藥相使，偏治風熱或溫毒上攻之咽喉腫痛、痄腮、熱毒腫痛與瘡瘍。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Niu Bang Zi disperses Wind-Heat, benefits the throat, vents rashes, and resolves toxic swelling; Lian Qiao clears Heat toxin and disperses clumps and swelling. Together they address Wind-Heat or warm-toxin throat swelling, mumps, toxic swelling, and sores.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱咽喉腫痛、痄腮、熱毒腫痛、瘡瘍或舌口潰瘍，尤見紅腫熱痛者。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat sore swollen throat, mumps, Heat-toxin swelling, sores, or mouth/tongue ulcerations with redness, swelling, heat, and pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 牛蒡子寒滑，氣虛便溏、腹瀉、脾胃虛寒者慎用或忌用；孕哺與降血糖/利尿藥併用需查來源。
pairs.caution_en: Niu Bang Zi is Cold and slippery; avoid or use cautiously in Qi-deficient loose stool, diarrhea, or Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold. Check source-layered pregnancy/lactation and hypoglycemic/diuretic drug cautions.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Man Jing Zi with Ju Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蔓荊子疏散頭面風熱、清利頭目；菊花疏風清熱、清肝明目。兩藥相使，偏治風熱或肝經風熱上攻所致頭痛、目赤腫痛、眼痛與頭面不適。此對藥來自 American Dragon major combinations，非 NCBAHM Appendix B 正式對藥。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Man Jing Zi disperses Wind-Heat from the head and face and benefits the head and eyes; Ju Hua disperses Wind-Heat and clears the Liver to brighten the eyes. Together they support Wind-Heat or Liver-channel Wind-Heat headache, red painful eyes, eye pain, and head/face discomfort. This pair is from American Dragon major combinations, not an NCBAHM Appendix B pair.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱頭痛、頭面疼痛、目赤腫痛、眼痛、流淚或眼前黑花，尤偏肝經風熱或肝火上炎者。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat headache, head/facial pain, red swollen painful eyes, eye pain, tearing, or spots before the eyes, especially from Liver-channel Wind-Heat or Liver Fire rising.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛、血虛所致頭痛或目疾者慎用蔓荊子；脾胃氣虛者慎用。菊花寒涼，脾胃虛寒、便溏或陽虛寒證者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use Man Jing Zi cautiously when headache or eye disorders are due to Yin or Blood deficiency, and in Spleen/Stomach Qi deficiency. Ju Hua is Cold and should be used cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, loose stool, or Yang-deficient Cold patterns.

pairs.name_en: Man Jing Zi with Fang Feng
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蔓荊子清利頭目、祛頭面風熱；防風祛風解表、勝濕止痛。兩藥相使，偏治風熱或風濕上擾所致頭痛、頭重、肩背痛與周身沉重疼痛。此對藥依 American Dragon major combinations 補入，非 NCBAHM Appendix B 正式對藥。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Man Jing Zi clears and benefits the head and eyes and dispels head/face Wind-Heat; Fang Feng releases the exterior, dispels Wind, overcomes Dampness, and relieves pain. Together they address Wind-Heat or superficial Wind-Damp headache, heavy head, shoulder/back pain, and generalized heaviness or pain. This pair is added from American Dragon major combinations, not an NCBAHM Appendix B pair.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱頭痛、頭面疼痛；或風濕頭痛、頭重身重、肩背疼痛。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat headache and head/facial pain, or Wind-Damp headache with heavy head/body and shoulder/back pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 蔓荊子對陰血不足頭痛目疾、脾胃氣虛者慎用；防風辛散，血虛痙急、陰虛火旺或表虛自汗者需辨證慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Use Man Jing Zi cautiously in Yin/Blood-deficiency headache or eye disorders and Spleen/Stomach Qi deficiency. Fang Feng is acrid-dispersing and requires caution in Blood-deficiency spasms, Yin-deficiency Fire, or exterior-deficiency sweating patterns.
pairs.actions_zh: 蔓荊子清利頭目、祛頭面風熱；防風祛風解表、勝濕止痛。兩藥相使，偏治風熱或風濕上擾所致頭痛、頭重、肩背痛與周身沉重疼痛。此對藥依 American Dragon major combinations 補入，非 NCBAHM Appendix B 正式對藥。
pairs.actions_en: Man Jing Zi clears and benefits the head and eyes and dispels head/face Wind-Heat; Fang Feng releases the exterior, dispels Wind, overcomes Dampness, and relieves pain. Together they address Wind-Heat or superficial Wind-Damp headache, heavy head, shoulder/back pain, and generalized heaviness or pain. This pair is added from American Dragon major combinations, not an NCBAHM Appendix B pair.

pairs.name_en: Fu Ping with Jing Jie, Bo He, and Lian Qiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 浮萍辛寒、發汗解表並透疹止癢；荊芥疏風透表，薄荷疏散風熱、清利頭目，連翹清熱解毒散結。此組依 American Dragon Major Combinations，用於風熱在表而發熱、無汗者；非 NCBAHM Appendix B 正式對藥。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ping is acrid-cold and releases the exterior through sweating while venting rashes and relieving itching; Jing Jie vents the exterior, Bo He disperses Wind-Heat and clears the head, and Lian Qiao clears Heat toxin and disperses constraint. This group is from American Dragon Major Combinations for Wind-Heat fever with lack of sweating, not an NCBAHM Appendix B pair.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱表證，發熱、身痛而無汗；兼熱毒、咽喉或皮膚風熱者尤可參考。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat exterior pattern with fever, body aches, and absence of sweating, especially when Heat toxin, throat symptoms, or Wind-Heat skin signs are present.
pairs.caution_zh: 浮萍發汗力強；表虛自汗、盜汗、氣血虛或陰虛口乾者禁忌。連翹與薄荷偏寒涼，脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Fu Ping is a strong diaphoretic; avoid in spontaneous sweating, night sweating, Qi/Blood deficiency, or Yin-deficiency dry mouth. Lian Qiao and Bo He are cooling and require caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: 考點方向：辛寒也能強發汗；不要把浮萍誤歸為一般溫和辛涼解表。

pairs.name_zh: 浮萍配薄荷、牛蒡子、蟬蛻、升麻
pairs.name_en: Fu Ping with Bo He, Niu Bang Zi, Chan Tui, and Sheng Ma
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 浮萍透疹止癢，薄荷疏散風熱，牛蒡子疏風利咽透疹，蟬蛻疏風透疹止癢，升麻升散透疹。此組依 American Dragon Major Combinations，偏治麻疹或風疹透發不暢。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ping vents rashes and relieves itching; Bo He disperses Wind-Heat; Niu Bang Zi disperses Wind-Heat, benefits the throat, and vents rashes; Chan Tui vents rashes and relieves itching; Sheng Ma lifts and vents rashes. This American Dragon combination targets incomplete expression of measles or Wind rash.
pairs.indication_zh: 麻疹、風疹或皮疹透發不暢，搔癢，兼風熱表證者。
pairs.indication_en: Measles, Wind rash, or incomplete rash expression with itching, especially with a Wind-Heat exterior pattern.
pairs.caution_zh: 疹已透、表虛自汗、血虛膚燥、陰虛盜汗者不宜強行發散；牛蒡子寒滑，便溏腹瀉者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Do not force diaphoresis when the rash has fully expressed or in exterior-deficiency sweating, Blood-deficiency dry skin, or Yin-deficiency night sweating. Niu Bang Zi is Cold and slippery; use caution with loose stool or diarrhea.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: 這組是皮膚/疹出方向，不是咳喘方向；浮萍不像麻黃能止喘。
pairs.actions_zh: 浮萍透疹止癢，薄荷疏散風熱，牛蒡子疏風利咽透疹，蟬蛻疏風透疹止癢，升麻升散透疹。此組依 American Dragon Major Combinations，偏治麻疹或風疹透發不暢。

This American Dragon combination targets incomplete expression of measles or Wind rash.

pairs.cautions_en: Do not force diaphoresis when the rash has fully expressed or in exterior-deficiency sweating, Blood-deficiency dry skin, or Yin-deficiency night sweating. Niu Bang Zi is Cold and slippery; use caution with loose stool or diarrhea.

pairs.name_en: Fu Ping with Ma Huang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 浮萍與麻黃皆能開腠理、發汗並通水道；浮萍辛寒偏風熱、皮疹與水腫，麻黃辛溫偏風寒、宣肺平喘。American Dragon 特別以此比較風水水腫、面腫、小便不利與無汗。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ping and Ma Huang both open the pores, promote sweating, and unblock fluid pathways. Fu Ping is acrid-cold and leans toward Wind-Heat, rash, itching, and edema; Ma Huang is acrid-warm and leans toward Wind-Cold with Lung wheezing. American Dragon highlights this comparison for Wind-edema with swollen face, urinary difficulty, and anhidrosis.
pairs.indication_zh: 風水水腫、面目浮腫、小便不利、無汗；需辨風熱/風寒與寒熱偏性。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-edema with swollen face, urinary difficulty, and absence of sweating; differentiate Wind-Heat versus Wind-Cold and the Cold/Heat direction of the pattern.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩者皆可發汗，虛汗、盜汗、氣血虛者禁忌。麻黃另有心血管、失眠與興奮劑交互作用風險；浮萍腎病與孕婦需慎用（CloudTCM）。
pairs.caution_en: Both can induce sweating and are inappropriate in deficiency sweating, night sweating, or Qi/Blood deficiency. Ma Huang also carries cardiovascular, insomnia, and stimulant-interaction risks; Fu Ping requires caution in kidney disease and pregnancy per CloudTCM.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: Chenoweth 寫「Diuretic, diaphoresis ≈ Ma Huang」；AD 補充：浮萍不治咳喘，麻黃才有宣肺平喘方向。

pairs.name_en: Fu Ping with Tian Hua Fen
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 浮萍辛寒發散風熱、透表泄熱；天花粉清熱生津。此組依 American Dragon Major Combinations，用於風熱兼口渴者。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ping acrid-coldly releases Wind-Heat and vents exterior Heat; Tian Hua Fen clears Heat and generates fluids. This American Dragon combination is used when Wind-Heat is accompanied by thirst.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱表證兼口渴、熱盛津傷傾向。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat exterior pattern with thirst or a tendency toward Heat damaging fluids.
pairs.caution_zh: 天花粉孕期禁忌需另查來源；浮萍孕婦慎用（CloudTCM），且表虛自汗、陰虛盜汗者禁用。
pairs.caution_en: Pregnancy contraindication/caution for Tian Hua Fen must be checked separately; Fu Ping is cautioned in pregnancy by CloudTCM and is contraindicated in exterior-deficiency spontaneous sweating or Yin-deficiency night sweating.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: 這組保留為 AD 補充組合；不是 NCBAHM Appendix B 對藥。

pairs.name_zh: 浮萍配白蒺藜、牛蒡子、薄荷
pairs.name_en: Fu Ping with Bai Ji Li, Niu Bang Zi, and Bo He
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 浮萍辛寒發汗、透表泄熱；白蒺藜祛風明目止癢並平肝；牛蒡子疏風熱、利咽透疹；薄荷疏散風熱、清利頭目。此組依 American Dragon Major Combinations，用於風熱發熱頭痛與皮膚/頭面風熱。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Ping acrid-coldly promotes sweating and vents exterior Heat; Bai Ji Li dispels Wind, benefits the eyes, relieves itching, and calms the Liver; Niu Bang Zi disperses Wind-Heat and vents rashes; Bo He disperses Wind-Heat and clears the head. This American Dragon combination supports Wind-Heat fever/headache and Wind-Heat affecting the skin, head, or eyes.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱發熱頭痛，兼頭目不利、皮膚風熱或疹癢者。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat fever and headache with head/eye discomfort, Wind-Heat skin signs, rash, or itching.
pairs.caution_zh: 浮萍發汗力強；表虛自汗、盜汗、氣血虛或陰虛津虧者禁忌。白蒺藜孕婦、血虛氣弱者慎用；牛蒡子便溏腹瀉者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Fu Ping is strongly diaphoretic; avoid in spontaneous sweating, night sweating, Qi/Blood deficiency, or Yin/fluid depletion. Use Bai Ji Li cautiously in pregnancy or Qi/Blood deficiency; use Niu Bang Zi cautiously with loose stool or diarrhea.
pairs.teaching_note_zh: 這是 AD 補充組合，非 NCBAHM Appendix B 正式對藥；白蒺藜已建 herb.bai_ji_li 以避免死連結。

pairs.name_en: Ba Dou with Wu Ling Zhi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 課件 Herb Functions 在「開閉／burst clogs」方向標出巴豆 s 五靈脂；巴豆峻猛開閉、破寒積痰閉，五靈脂活血止痛、散瘀通絡。兩藥相使，偏處理寒凝、痰瘀互結、閉阻疼痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chenoweth Herb Functions marks Ba Dou with Wu Ling Zhi in the 'bursts clogs' direction. Ba Dou forcefully opens Cold accumulation and Phlegm obstruction; Wu Ling Zhi moves Blood, dispels stasis, and relieves pain. Together they support obstruction-breaking in Cold, Phlegm, and stasis patterns.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒凝痰瘀閉阻、腹痛或頑固疼痛；作 board 配伍記憶，不作一般臨床自用。
pairs.indication_en: Cold, Phlegm, and Blood-stasis obstruction with abdominal or stubborn pain; board-memory pairing, not routine self-use.
pairs.caution_zh: 巴豆大毒，孕婦、哺乳、體弱、無寒積者禁用；不可熱飲、不可生用或超量。五靈脂活血，出血傾向與孕期亦須慎辨。
pairs.caution_en: Ba Dou is very toxic and contraindicated in pregnancy, breastfeeding, weak patients, and non-Cold accumulation; avoid hot beverages, raw use, and overdose. Wu Ling Zhi moves Blood, so bleeding tendency and pregnancy require caution.

pairs.name_en: Ba Dou with Da Huang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: AD 以巴豆與大黃比較瀉下方向：巴豆辛熱大毒，攻寒積；大黃苦寒，瀉熱結並兼活血解毒。此組重在辨寒熱與毒性，不是常規相須。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: AD contrasts Ba Dou and Da Huang as purgatives: Ba Dou is acrid-hot and very toxic for Cold accumulation; Da Huang is bitter-cold for Heat accumulation with Blood-stasis/toxin directions. This is primarily a Cold/Heat and toxicity contrast, not a routine mutual-assistance pair.
pairs.indication_zh: 瀉下藥寒熱鑑別：寒積閉結偏巴豆；陽明熱結、熱毒瘀滯偏大黃。
pairs.indication_en: Purgative differentiation: Cold accumulation obstruction points toward Ba Dou; Yangming Heat accumulation, Heat toxin, and stasis point toward Da Huang.
pairs.caution_zh: 巴豆與大黃同屬攻下，不得因皆瀉下而混用；CloudTCM 古籍層另列巴豆畏大黃，需保留來源差異。
pairs.caution_en: Do not combine or substitute simply because both purge downward. CloudTCM's classical layer also lists Ba Dou as fearing Da Huang, so the source difference should remain visible.

pairs.name_en: Ba Dou with Gan Jiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: AD major combinations 將巴豆與乾薑列於內寒積聚方向；巴豆峻下寒積，乾薑溫中散寒，兩者同向加強寒積閉阻之溫通攻逐。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: AD major combinations place Ba Dou with Gan Jiang for interior Cold accumulation. Ba Dou forcefully purges Cold accumulation while Gan Jiang warms the middle and disperses Cold; together they emphasize warming and driving out Cold obstruction.
pairs.indication_zh: 內寒積聚、腹滿冷痛、寒積閉結。
pairs.indication_en: Interior Cold accumulation with abdominal fullness, cold pain, and obstructed bowels.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥皆偏熱；陰虛、熱結、出血熱象或孕哺禁忌需避開，巴豆另有大毒與小劑量限制。
pairs.caution_en: Both are warming/hot; avoid in Yin deficiency, Heat accumulation, Heat-type bleeding, pregnancy or lactation. Ba Dou also carries very-toxic minute-dose restrictions.
pairs.actions_zh: AD major combinations 將巴豆與乾薑列於內寒積聚方向；巴豆峻下寒積，乾薑溫中散寒，兩者同向加強寒積閉阻之溫通攻逐。
pairs.actions_en: AD major combinations place Ba Dou with Gan Jiang for interior Cold accumulation. Ba Dou forcefully purges Cold accumulation while Gan Jiang warms the middle and disperses Cold; together they emphasize warming and driving out Cold obstruction.
pairs.indications_zh: 內寒積聚、腹滿冷痛、寒積閉結。
pairs.indications_en: Interior Cold accumulation with abdominal fullness, cold pain, and obstructed bowels.
pairs.cautions_zh: 兩藥皆偏熱；陰虛、熱結、出血熱象或孕哺禁忌需避開，巴豆另有大毒與小劑量限制。
pairs.cautions_en: Both are warming/hot; avoid in Yin deficiency, Heat accumulation, Heat-type bleeding, pregnancy or lactation. Ba Dou also carries very-toxic minute-dose restrictions.

pairs.name_en: Zhi Chuan Wu with Zhi Cao Wu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 二者同為烏頭類高毒祛風濕止痛藥；制川烏祛寒濕止痛，制草烏更強更毒。AD notes 指二者常作外用膏藥止痛基礎。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Both are highly toxic aconite-root medicines for Wind-Damp-Cold pain. Zhi Chuan Wu dispels Cold-Damp and stops pain; Zhi Cao Wu is stronger and more toxic. AD notes they often form the basis of topical plasters for musculoskeletal pain.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒濕痹痛劇烈、筋骨關節疼痛、肌肉痙攣疼痛，尤偏外用膏藥或專科處方。
pairs.indication_en: Severe Cold-Damp Bi pain, bone/joint pain, or spasmodic muscle pain, especially in topical plasters or specialist prescriptions.
pairs.caution_zh: 雙重烏頭類毒性；孕禁、未炮製禁、陰虛熱痛禁，心律不整/抗心律不整藥者極慎。不得自行內服。
pairs.caution_en: Dual aconite toxicity. Contraindicated in pregnancy, unprocessed use, Yin deficiency, and Heat-type pain; extreme caution with arrhythmia history or antiarrhythmic drugs. Do not self-administer internally.

pairs.name_en: Zhi Chuan Wu with Ma Huang and Bai Shao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: AD major combinations 將制川烏配麻黃、白芍（並可加黃耆）用於全身關節疼痛與活動受限。制川烏溫經散寒止痛，麻黃宣散寒濕、開腠理，白芍養血柔筋止痛以緩急。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: AD major combinations pair Zhi Chuan Wu with Ma Huang and Bai Shao (optionally Huang Qi) for generalized joint pain with restricted range of motion. Zhi Chuan Wu warms channels and stops pain; Ma Huang disperses Cold-Damp and opens the pores; Bai Shao nourishes Blood, softens sinews, and relieves spasm.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒濕痹、全身關節疼痛、活動受限，寒象明顯者。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Cold-Damp painful obstruction with generalized joint pain and restricted movement, especially when Cold signs are clear.
pairs.caution_zh: 制川烏高毒需炮製先煎；麻黃有心血管/失眠/興奮劑風險；白芍較緩但不可抵消烏頭毒性。
pairs.caution_en: Zhi Chuan Wu is highly toxic and requires processing and pre-decoction; Ma Huang carries cardiovascular, insomnia, and stimulant risks; Bai Shao moderates spasm but does not neutralize aconite toxicity.
pairs.actions_zh: AD major combinations 將制川烏配麻黃、白芍（並可加黃耆）用於全身關節疼痛與活動受限。制川烏溫經散寒止痛，麻黃宣散寒濕、開腠理，白芍養血柔筋止痛以緩急。

pairs.name_en: Niu Huang with Shui Niu Jiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 牛黃清心開竅、化痰息風；水牛角清營涼血、解毒定驚。AD 將二者列於熱入心包/營血分之神昏譫語、煩躁、抽搐。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Niu Huang clears the Heart, opens the orifices, transforms Phlegm, and extinguishes Wind; Shui Niu Jiao clears Ying-level Heat, cools Blood, resolves toxicity, and calms convulsions. AD pairs them for Heat attacking the Pericardium/Ying-Xue levels with delirium, irritability, and convulsions.
pairs.indication_zh: 溫病熱入心包或營血分：高熱、神昏譫語、煩躁、抽搐。
pairs.indication_en: Warm disease Heat entering the Pericardium or Ying-Xue levels: high fever, delirium, irritability, and convulsions.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩者皆偏寒涼清熱，非實熱閉證或中焦虛寒者不宜；牛黃孕禁/鎮靜交互作用，水牛角孕期慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Both are cold Heat-clearing substances and are inappropriate without Excess Heat closure or in Middle-Jiao deficiency-cold. Niu Huang is contraindicated in pregnancy and has sedative interactions; Shui Niu Jiao requires pregnancy caution.
pairs.actions_zh: 牛黃清心開竅、化痰息風；水牛角清營涼血、解毒定驚。AD 將二者列於熱入心包/營血分之神昏譫語、煩躁、抽搐。

pairs.name_en: Niu Huang with She Xiang and Bing Pian
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 牛黃清熱化痰開竅，麝香芳香走竄醒神，冰片開竅清熱止痛。課件以安宮牛黃丸記熱閉神昏；AD 亦列 severe Heat and blocked orifices。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Niu Huang clears Heat, transforms Phlegm, and opens orifices; She Xiang powerfully aromatically opens and awakens; Bing Pian opens orifices and clears Heat/pain. Course notes use An Gong Niu Huang Wan for Heat-closure coma, and AD lists severe Heat with blocked orifices.
pairs.indication_zh: 熱閉神昏、熱病譫語、高熱抽搐、痰熱閉竅。
pairs.indication_en: Heat-closure impaired consciousness, febrile delirium, high-fever convulsions, and Phlegm-Heat blocking the orifices.
pairs.caution_zh: 麝香孕禁且芳香走竄；牛黃孕禁/慎孕與鎮靜交互作用；冰片芳香藥不宜久煎。寒閉不用此方向。
pairs.caution_en: She Xiang is contraindicated in pregnancy and strongly penetrating; Niu Huang carries pregnancy and sedative-interaction concerns; Bing Pian is aromatic and should not be long-decocted. Do not use this Heat-opening direction for Cold closure.
pairs.actions_zh: 牛黃清熱化痰開竅，麝香芳香走竄醒神，冰片開竅清熱止痛。課件以安宮牛黃丸記熱閉神昏；AD 亦列 severe Heat and blocked orifices。

pairs.indications_en: Heat-closure impaired consciousness, febrile delirium, high-fever convulsions, and Phlegm-Heat blocking the orifices.

pairs.name_en: Shui Niu Jiao with Sheng Di Huang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 水牛角清營涼血解毒，生地黃清熱涼血並養陰生津。AD 將此組列於血熱吐衄、紫斑與神昏。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shui Niu Jiao clears Ying-level Heat, cools Blood, and resolves toxicity; Sheng Di Huang cools Blood while nourishing Yin and generating fluids. AD uses this direction for Blood-Heat bleeding, purpura, and delirium.
pairs.indication_zh: 熱入營血、吐血衄血、紫斑、斑疹、神昏譫語。
pairs.indication_en: Heat entering Ying/Blood with hematemesis, epistaxis, purpura, rashes, delirium, or impaired consciousness.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥寒涼，脾胃虛寒、食少便溏者慎用；水牛角需先煎或用濃縮粉。
pairs.caution_en: Both are cold; use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold with poor appetite or loose stool. Shui Niu Jiao requires pre-decoction or concentrated powder.
pairs.actions_zh: 水牛角清營涼血解毒，生地黃清熱涼血並養陰生津。AD 將此組列於血熱吐衄、紫斑與神昏。

pairs.name_en: Shui Niu Jiao with Mu Dan Pi and Chi Shao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 水牛角清血分熱毒，牡丹皮清熱涼血兼活血散瘀，赤芍清熱涼血、散瘀止痛。AD 列此組可加強涼血作用。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shui Niu Jiao clears Blood-level Heat toxin; Mu Dan Pi cools Blood and moves Blood stasis; Chi Shao cools Blood, dispels stasis, and relieves pain. AD notes this combination strengthens Blood-cooling action.
pairs.indication_zh: 血熱發斑、紫斑、吐衄、熱毒入血兼瘀者。
pairs.indication_en: Blood-Heat rashes, purpura, hematemesis/epistaxis, and Heat toxin entering the Blood with stasis.
pairs.caution_zh: 寒涼且兼活血，虛寒、孕期、出血非血熱者需慎辨。
pairs.caution_en: Cold and partly Blood-moving; differentiate carefully in deficiency-cold, pregnancy, or bleeding not due to Blood Heat.
pairs.actions_zh: 水牛角清血分熱毒，牡丹皮清熱涼血兼活血散瘀，赤芍清熱涼血、散瘀止痛。AD 列此組可加強涼血作用。

pairs.cautions_zh: 寒涼且兼活血，虛寒、孕期、出血非血熱者需慎辨。
pairs.cautions_en: Cold and partly Blood-moving; differentiate carefully in deficiency-cold, pregnancy, or bleeding not due to Blood Heat.

pairs.name_en: Wu Gong with Quan Xie
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蜈蚣與全蠍皆息風止痙、通絡止痛；蜈蚣力更猛、攻毒散結較強。AD 與課件均列常配，用於嚴重抽搐、痙攣、頑固偏頭痛與風濕痹痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Wu Gong and Quan Xie both extinguish Wind, stop spasms, unblock collaterals, and relieve pain; Wu Gong is stronger and more forceful at attacking toxins and nodules. AD and course materials list the pair for severe convulsions, spasms, stubborn migraine, and Bi pain.
pairs.indication_zh: 急慢驚風、抽搐痙攣、角弓反張、牙關緊閉、頑固偏頭痛、風濕痹痛。
pairs.indication_en: Acute/chronic convulsions, spasms, opisthotonos, lockjaw, stubborn migraine, and Wind-Damp Bi pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩者皆有毒；孕婦禁用，血虛或慢驚虛證禁用/慎用，不得超量或久用。
pairs.caution_en: Both are toxic; contraindicated in pregnancy, avoid or use cautiously in Blood deficiency or deficiency-type chronic convulsions, and do not overdose or use long-term.

pairs.name_en: Han Fang Ji with Huang Qi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 防己利水祛濕、通痺止痛；黃耆益氣固表、扶正行水。課件以防己黃耆湯提示「水腫兼汗出惡風、身重、脈浮」的虛實夾雜水濕證。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Han Fang Ji drains water, dispels Damp, and relieves Bi pain; Huang Qi tonifies Qi, secures the exterior, and supports water movement. Course materials point to Fang Ji Huang Qi Tang for edema with sweating, aversion to wind, heaviness, and a floating pulse.
pairs.indication_zh: 虛性水腫、汗出惡風、身重、脈浮；防己黃耆湯證。
pairs.indication_en: Deficiency-type edema with sweating, aversion to wind, heaviness, and floating pulse; Fang Ji Huang Qi Tang pattern.
pairs.caution_zh: 若防己品種不明須先排除廣防己/木防己毒性來源；陰虛、脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: If the Fang Ji species is unclear, first exclude toxic Guang/Mu Fang Ji sources; use cautiously in Yin deficiency or Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.

pairs.cautions_zh: 若防己品種不明須先排除廣防己/木防己毒性來源；陰虛、脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.cautions_en: If the Fang Ji species is unclear, first exclude toxic Guang/Mu Fang Ji sources; use cautiously in Yin deficiency or Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.

pairs.name_en: Han Fang Ji with Gui Zhi and Fu Ling
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 防己祛風利水，桂枝通陽化氣，茯苓滲濕利水；AD 與課件方義皆提示水濕在表裡、腹水或水腫時可用此組思路。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Han Fang Ji dispels Wind and promotes urination, Gui Zhi warms yang and transforms qi, and Fu Ling leaches Damp and drains water. American Dragon and course formula logic support this direction for water-damp obstruction, ascites, or edema.
pairs.indication_zh: 水腫、腹水、水濕壅滯兼氣化不利。
pairs.indication_en: Edema, ascites, or water-damp obstruction with impaired qi transformation.
pairs.caution_zh: 寒熱虛實須辨；防己苦寒，脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Differentiate Cold/Heat and deficiency/excess; Han Fang Ji is bitter-cold and requires caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.

pairs.cautions_zh: 寒熱虛實須辨；防己苦寒，脾胃虛寒者慎用。
pairs.cautions_en: Differentiate Cold/Heat and deficiency/excess; Han Fang Ji is bitter-cold and requires caution in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang Gen with Huang Qi and Mu Li
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃根收斂止汗，黃耆益氣固表，牡蠣斂陰潛陽、收澀止汗；AD 列此類組合治自汗、盜汗與虛性汗出。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang Gen restrains sweating, Huang Qi tonifies Qi and secures the exterior, and Mu Li astringes Yin and restrains sweating. American Dragon lists this direction for spontaneous, night, and deficiency sweating.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣虛自汗、陰虛盜汗、虛性汗出。
pairs.indication_en: Qi-deficiency spontaneous sweating, Yin-deficiency night sweats, and deficiency sweating.
pairs.caution_zh: 有表邪者忌用，勿過早收汗。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated with an exterior pathogen; do not restrain sweating too early.
pairs.actions_zh: 麻黃根收斂止汗，黃耆益氣固表，牡蠣斂陰潛陽、收澀止汗；AD 列此類組合治自汗、盜汗與虛性汗出。

pairs.cautions_en: Contraindicated with an exterior pathogen; do not restrain sweating too early.

pairs.name_en: Ma Huang Gen with Fu Xiao Mai and Huang Qi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 麻黃根專止汗，浮小麥益心斂汗，黃耆益氣固表；課件比較麻黃根與浮小麥，AD 也列麻黃根配黃耆、浮小麥治自汗。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ma Huang Gen focuses on stopping sweating, Fu Xiao Mai nourishes Heart/Yin context and restrains sweating, and Huang Qi tonifies Qi and secures the exterior. The course compares Ma Huang Gen with Fu Xiao Mai, and American Dragon lists Ma Huang Gen with Huang Qi and Fu Xiao Mai for spontaneous sweating.
pairs.indication_zh: 自汗、盜汗、氣虛表不固兼心陰虛語境。
pairs.indication_en: Spontaneous or night sweating from unsecured exterior Qi with Heart/Yin-deficiency context.
pairs.caution_zh: 外感表證、邪未解者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in exterior patterns or when the pathogen has not been resolved.

pairs.name_en: Jue Ming Zi with Ju Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 決明子清肝明目、兼潤腸；菊花疏風清熱、平肝明目。AD 多處列二者合用，治風熱或肝火目赤腫痛、畏光流淚、頭痛眩暈。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jue Ming Zi clears the Liver, brightens the eyes, and moistens the Intestines; Ju Hua disperses Wind-Heat, pacifies the Liver, and brightens the eyes. American Dragon repeatedly lists the pair for Wind-Heat or Liver-Fire eye redness, swelling, photophobia, tearing, headache, and dizziness.
pairs.indication_zh: 目赤腫痛、畏光流淚、頭痛眩暈，屬風熱犯肝或肝火上炎。
pairs.indication_en: Red, swollen, painful eyes, photophobia, tearing, headache, and dizziness due to Wind-Heat attacking the Liver or Liver Fire.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒泄瀉、低血壓或孕期者先看決明子禁忌；菊花來源差異另見菊花卡。
pairs.caution_en: Check Jue Ming Zi contraindications first in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold diarrhea, hypotension, or pregnancy; see the Ju Hua card for Ju Hua source differences.

pairs.name_en: Jue Ming Zi with Xia Ku Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 決明子清肝明目、平肝潛陽，夏枯草清肝火、散結；AD 列於肝火目疾、眼痛夜甚、頭痛眩暈與高血壓語境。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jue Ming Zi clears Liver Heat, brightens the eyes, and anchors Liver Yang, while Xia Ku Cao clears Liver Fire and dissipates nodules. American Dragon lists this direction for Liver-Fire eye disorders, night-worse eye pain, headache, dizziness, and hypertension contexts.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝火目赤腫痛、眼痛夜甚、頭痛眩暈、高血壓。
pairs.indication_en: Liver-Fire red swollen painful eyes, eye pain worse at night, headache, dizziness, and hypertension.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥皆偏清肝降火，脾胃虛寒、便溏或低血壓者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Both herbs clear Liver Heat/Fire; use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, loose stools, or hypotension.

pairs.actions_en: Jue Ming Zi clears Liver Heat, brightens the eyes, and anchors Liver Yang, while Xia Ku Cao clears Liver Fire and dissipates nodules. American Dragon lists this direction for Liver-Fire eye disorders, night-worse eye pain, headache, dizziness, and hypertension contexts.

pairs.cautions_zh: 兩藥皆偏清肝降火，脾胃虛寒、便溏或低血壓者慎用。
pairs.cautions_en: Both herbs clear Liver Heat/Fire; use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold, loose stools, or hypotension.

pairs.name_en: Mu Zei with Ju Hua
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 木賊散風熱、退翳障；菊花疏風清熱、平肝明目。課件與 AD 均把木賊放在風熱/肝熱眼科配伍中，用於目赤腫痛、雲翳、畏光流淚。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Mu Zei disperses Wind-Heat and eliminates superficial visual obstruction; Ju Hua disperses Wind-Heat, pacifies the Liver, and brightens the eyes. Course materials and American Dragon both place Mu Zei in eye-focused Wind-Heat/Liver-Heat combinations.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱或肝熱目赤腫痛、雲翳、畏光流淚。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat or Liver-Heat red, swollen, painful eyes with cloudiness, photophobia, and tearing.
pairs.caution_zh: 若屬肝陽上亢目赤、津液虧耗或孕期，先看木賊慎用欄。
pairs.caution_en: If red eyes are from Liver Yang Rising, depleted fluids, or pregnancy, check Mu Zei cautions first.

pairs.name_en: Mu Zei with Bai Ji Li
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 木賊較強於散風熱、退翳；白蒺藜疏肝祛風、明目止癢。AD 特別比較二者：白蒺藜較能平肝除障，木賊散發作用較強。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Mu Zei is stronger at dispersing Wind-Heat and removing superficial visual obstruction; Bai Ji Li courses the Liver, dispels Wind, brightens the eyes, and stops itching. American Dragon specifically compares their complementary strengths.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱目疾、胬肉翳障、流淚、皮膚瘙癢。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat eye disorders, pterygium or superficial visual obstruction, tearing, and itching skin.
pairs.caution_zh: 兩藥皆偏走散風；體虛、孕期或津液不足者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Both disperse Wind; use cautiously in deficiency, pregnancy, or depleted fluids.
pairs.actions_zh: 木賊較強於散風熱、退翳；白蒺藜疏肝祛風、明目止癢。AD 特別比較二者：白蒺藜較能平肝除障，木賊散發作用較強。

pairs.name_zh: 白花蛇配羌活、防風、秦艽
pairs.name_en: Bai Hua She with Qiang Huo, Fang Feng, and Qin Jiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白花蛇強力祛風通絡、透筋骨；羌活、防風、秦艽分別祛風濕、止痺痛。AD 列此組治風濕關節痛、肢體無力僵硬。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Hua She powerfully dispels Wind and unblocks collaterals; Qiang Huo, Fang Feng, and Qin Jiao assist in dispelling Wind-Damp and relieving Bi pain. American Dragon lists this group for Wind-Damp joint pain, weakness, and stiffness.
pairs.indication_zh: 風濕痺痛、關節痛、肢體無力僵硬。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Damp Bi pain, joint pain, limb weakness, and stiffness.
pairs.caution_zh: 白花蛇有毒；孕期、抗凝/抗血小板藥、血虛生風者需避用或嚴格審核。
pairs.caution_en: Bai Hua She is toxic; pregnancy, anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, and Wind from Blood deficiency require avoidance or strict review.

pairs.cautions_en: Bai Hua She is toxic; pregnancy, anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, and Wind from Blood deficiency require avoidance or strict review.

pairs.name_en: Bai Hua She with Wu Gong and Quan Xie
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 三藥皆偏強力息風通絡；白花蛇祛風透筋骨，蜈蚣、全蠍息風止痙、通絡止痛。AD 列白花蛇與蜈蚣/全蠍語境治痙攣、破傷風及頑固痺痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: All three are forceful Wind-extinguishing and collateral-unblocking substances. Bai Hua She dispels Wind through sinews and bones, while Wu Gong and Quan Xie extinguish Wind, stop spasms, unblock collaterals, and relieve pain. American Dragon places these combinations in spasm, tetany/tetanus, and stubborn Bi contexts.
pairs.indication_zh: 痙攣、抽搐、破傷風、頑固痺痛。
pairs.indication_en: Spasms, convulsions, tetany/tetanus, and stubborn Bi pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 高毒性組合；孕婦禁用，血虛或肝腎功能風險者慎避，需嚴格劑量審核。
pairs.caution_en: High-toxicity combination; contraindicated in pregnancy, avoid or use extreme caution with Blood deficiency or liver/kidney risk, and requires strict dose review.

pairs.cautions_en: High-toxicity combination; contraindicated in pregnancy, avoid or use extreme caution with Blood deficiency or liver/kidney risk, and requires strict dose review.

pairs.name_en: Liu Huang with Fu Zi and Rou Gui
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 硫黃補命門火、助腎陽；附子、肉桂溫腎助陽、回陽散寒。課件與 AD 都以此方向提示腎陽虛、腎不納氣喘與下焦虛寒。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Liu Huang tonifies Ming Men Fire and strengthens Kidney Yang; Fu Zi and Rou Gui warm Kidney Yang and disperse Cold. Course materials and American Dragon both support this direction for Kidney Yang deficiency, Kidney failing to grasp Qi asthma, and Lower Jiao Cold-deficiency.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽虛、腎不納氣喘、腰膝冷痛、下焦虛寒。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency, asthma from Kidneys failing to grasp Qi, cold painful low back and knees, and Lower Jiao Cold-deficiency.
pairs.caution_zh: 三藥皆熱，硫黃與附子皆高風險；孕期禁用，陰虛熱證禁用，嚴格審核劑量與炮製。
pairs.caution_en: All three are hot, and Liu Huang/Fu Zi are high-risk; contraindicated in pregnancy and Yin-deficiency Heat, with strict dose and processing review required.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III-Topical & Expel Parasite Herbs.md#L184-L220

pairs.name_en: Liu Huang with Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: AD 與 Chenoweth abbreviated 都列硫黃、半夏用於虛寒便秘／寒結不通方向（Ban Liu Wan）。硫黃溫腎陽、通寒結，半夏降逆化痰、和胃。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: American Dragon and Chenoweth abbreviated notes list Liu Huang with Ban Xia for Cold-deficiency constipation / Cold obstruction (Ban Liu Wan direction). Liu Huang warms Kidney Yang and unblocks Cold accumulation, while Ban Xia redirects rebellion, transforms Phlegm, and harmonizes the Stomach.
pairs.indication_zh: 老人或腎陽虛寒之便秘、寒結不通。
pairs.indication_en: Elderly or Kidney-Yang-deficiency Cold constipation and Cold obstruction.
pairs.caution_zh: 硫黃有毒且熱；陰虛熱、孕期、非寒證便秘不宜。半夏亦需炮製與劑量審核。
pairs.caution_en: Liu Huang is toxic and hot; avoid in Yin-deficiency Heat, pregnancy, or non-Cold constipation. Ban Xia also requires processing and dose review.

pairs.name_zh: 白果配麻黃、紫蘇子、杏仁
pairs.name_en: Bai Guo with Ma Huang, Zi Su Zi, and Xing Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白果斂肺定喘並化痰；麻黃宣肺平喘，紫蘇子、杏仁降肺氣化痰止咳。課件列此為喘咳 wheezing combination，一收一宣、一降一化，使喘咳痰多兼具收斂與宣降。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Guo astringes the Lung and stops wheezing while transforming Phlegm; Ma Huang diffuses the Lung and calms wheezing, while Zi Su Zi and Xing Ren descend Lung Qi and transform Phlegm. The course lists this as a wheezing combination.
pairs.indication_zh: 喘咳痰多、肺氣上逆；較適合非外感初起之慢性或痰喘方向。
pairs.indication_en: Wheezing cough with copious Phlegm and rebellious Lung Qi, especially when not in the initial exterior stage.
pairs.caution_zh: 白果收澀且小毒；外感初起、實證或黃黏痰未清者禁用。麻黃有心血管與興奮風險，需審核劑量與禁忌。
pairs.caution_en: Bai Guo is astringent and slightly toxic; avoid in early exterior, Excess, or thick yellow Phlegm patterns. Ma Huang carries cardiovascular/stimulant risks and requires dose and contraindication review.
