pairs.name_en: Bi Ba with Gao Liang Jiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 兩藥皆辛熱溫中止痛；蓽茇溫中散寒、下氣止痛，高良薑溫胃散寒、止嘔止痛。課件列高良薑、蓽茇用於胃寒嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Both are acrid-hot Middle-warming pain-relievers. Bi Ba warms the Middle, disperses Cold, descends Qi, and relieves pain; Gao Liang Jiang warms the Stomach, disperses Cold, stops vomiting, and relieves pain.
pairs.indication_zh: 胃寒或中焦寒凝：脘腹冷痛、嘔吐清水、泄瀉、噯氣呃逆。
pairs.indication_en: Stomach Cold or Middle Jiao Cold congealing with cold epigastric/abdominal pain, vomiting clear fluids, diarrhea, belching, or hiccup.
pairs.caution_zh: 辛熱燥烈；陰虛火旺、實熱、口乾便秘明顯者禁用或慎避。
pairs.caution_en: Acrid, hot, and drying; contraindicated or avoided in Yin-deficiency Fire, Excess Heat, marked dryness, or constipation.
pairs.actions_zh: 兩藥皆辛熱溫中止痛；蓽茇溫中散寒、下氣止痛，高良薑溫胃散寒、止嘔止痛。課件列高良薑、蓽茇用於胃寒嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛。
pairs.actions_en: Both are acrid-hot Middle-warming pain-relievers. Bi Ba warms the Middle, disperses Cold, descends Qi, and relieves pain; Gao Liang Jiang warms the Stomach, disperses Cold, stops vomiting, and relieves pain.
pairs.indications_zh: 胃寒或中焦寒凝：脘腹冷痛、嘔吐清水、泄瀉、噯氣呃逆。
pairs.indications_en: Stomach Cold or Middle Jiao Cold congealing with cold epigastric/abdominal pain, vomiting clear fluids, diarrhea, belching, or hiccup.
pairs.cautions_zh: 辛熱燥烈；陰虛火旺、實熱、口乾便秘明顯者禁用或慎避。
pairs.cautions_en: Acrid, hot, and drying; contraindicated or avoided in Yin-deficiency Fire, Excess Heat, marked dryness, or constipation.

pairs.name_en: Bi Ba with Yan Hu Suo and Xi Xin
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 課件理氣頁列三藥用於寒凝氣滯胸痛。蓽茇溫散寒凝、下氣止痛；延胡索活血行氣止痛；細辛辛溫散寒止痛，三藥合用偏寒凝氣血阻滯疼痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: The course Qi-regulating module lists this trio for chest pain from Cold and Qi stagnation. Bi Ba warms and descends, Yan Hu Suo moves Qi and Blood to stop pain, and Xi Xin disperses Cold and relieves pain.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒凝氣滯或寒凝血滯之胸痛、胸腹疼痛。
pairs.indication_en: Chest or chest-abdominal pain from Cold congealing with Qi/Blood stagnation.
pairs.caution_zh: 辛溫走散且止痛力強；熱證、陰虛火旺禁用。細辛與延胡索另有安全與用藥交互作用需審核。
pairs.caution_en: Acrid-warm and dispersing; contraindicated in Heat patterns and Yin-deficiency Fire. Xi Xin and Yan Hu Suo require separate safety and interaction review.

pairs.name_en: Bi Xie with Yi Zhi Ren and Wu Yao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 萆薢分清去濁；益智仁溫腎固攝，烏藥行氣溫下焦。AD 列此組用於陽虛小便頻數或尿失禁；課件亦列萆薢治下焦濁濕可配益智仁、烏藥。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bi Xie separates the pure from the turbid; Yi Zhi Ren warms the Kidney and secures, while Wu Yao moves Qi and warms the Lower Jiao. American Dragon lists this direction for Yang-deficiency urinary frequency or incontinence.
pairs.indication_zh: 下焦虛寒或陽虛之小便頻數、尿失禁、白濁帶下兼濁濕不分。
pairs.indication_en: Lower Jiao deficiency-Cold or Yang deficiency with urinary frequency, incontinence, turbid urine, or discharge.
pairs.caution_zh: 若屬濕熱熾盛、陰虛火旺或下部無濕，不宜誤用溫攝組合。
pairs.caution_en: Do not use this warming-securing combination in blazing Damp-Heat, Yin-deficiency Fire, or absence of Dampness below.

pairs.name_zh: 萆薢配車前子、滑石、黃柏
pairs.name_en: Bi Xie with Che Qian Zi, Hua Shi, and Huang Bai
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 萆薢分清別濁；車前子、滑石清利濕熱通淋，黃柏清下焦濕熱。AD 列此組用於濕熱下注之尿頻、尿濁、帶下與舌紅苔黃膩。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bi Xie separates clear from turbid; Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi drain Damp-Heat through urination, and Huang Bai clears Lower Jiao Damp-Heat. American Dragon lists this group for Damp-Heat pouring downward.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱下注：尿頻、尿濁、白濁、帶下、舌紅苔黃膩。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat pouring downward with urinary frequency, cloudy urine, turbid discharge, vaginal discharge, red tongue and yellow greasy coat.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、下部無濕或腎陰虛腰痛者禁用萆薢；苦寒利濕組合易傷正，虛寒者慎避。
pairs.caution_en: Bi Xie is contraindicated in Yin-deficiency Fire, absence of Dampness below, or low back pain from Kidney Yin deficiency; this bitter-cold draining combination may damage deficiency-Cold patients.

pairs.name_zh: 沉香配烏藥、肉桂、小茴香
pairs.name_en: Chen Xiang with Wu Yao, Rou Gui, and Xiao Hui Xiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 沉香溫中降逆、行氣止痛並助腎納氣；烏藥行氣散寒，肉桂溫陽散寒，小茴香暖肝腎散寒。此組相使，偏治寒凝氣滯之少腹、胸腹冷痛與寒疝。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chen Xiang warms the Middle, descends rebellion, and moves Qi; Wu Yao moves Qi and disperses Cold, Rou Gui warms Yang, and Xiao Hui Xiang warms the Liver/Kidney. Together they address Cold-congealed Qi stagnation pain and Cold hernia.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒凝氣滯：少腹冷痛、寒疝、胸腹脹痛、胸膈痞悶喘滿。
pairs.indication_en: Cold-congealed Qi stagnation with lower-abdominal Cold pain, Cold hernia, chest/abdominal distention and pain, chest oppression, wheezing, and fullness.
pairs.caution_zh: 溫燥行散，陰虛火旺、實熱、心經實邪者禁用；孕期慎用沉香。
pairs.caution_en: Warm, drying, and dispersing; contraindicated in Yin-deficiency Fire, Excess Heat, or pathogenic Excess in the Heart channel. Use Chen Xiang cautiously during pregnancy.
pairs.actions_zh: 沉香溫中降逆、行氣止痛並助腎納氣；烏藥行氣散寒，肉桂溫陽散寒，小茴香暖肝腎散寒。此組相使，偏治寒凝氣滯之少腹、胸腹冷痛與寒疝。

pairs.name_zh: 赤小豆配麻黃、連翹、桑白皮
pairs.name_en: Chi Xiao Dou with Ma Huang, Lian Qiao, and Sang Bai Pi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 赤小豆利水滲濕、退黃；麻黃開表宣肺，連翹清熱解毒，桑白皮瀉肺利水。相使使濕熱黃疸由汗與小便分消。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chi Xiao Dou drains Dampness and resolves jaundice; Ma Huang opens the exterior and diffuses Lung Qi, Lian Qiao clears Heat toxin, and Sang Bai Pi drains Lung Heat and promotes urination. Together they disperse Damp-Heat jaundice through sweat and urination.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱黃疸輕證或表鬱濕熱：身黃、小便不利、表邪未解。
pairs.indication_en: Mild Damp-Heat jaundice or Damp-Heat with exterior constraint: jaundice, urinary difficulty, and unresolved exterior signs.
pairs.caution_zh: 麻黃辛溫發汗，汗多、心悸、高血壓或孕期需慎；無濕象者不宜赤小豆。
pairs.caution_en: Ma Huang is acrid-warm and diaphoretic; use caution with sweating, palpitations, hypertension, or pregnancy. Chi Xiao Dou is unsuitable without Dampness signs.

pairs.name_zh: 川木通配車前子、梔子、滑石
pairs.name_en: Chuan Mu Tong with Che Qian Zi, Zhi Zi, and Hua Shi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 川木通清心火並利尿通淋；車前子、滑石清利濕熱，梔子清三焦火熱並導熱下行。相使治濕熱淋證與心火移小腸。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chuan Mu Tong clears Heart Fire and promotes urination; Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi drain Damp-Heat, while Zhi Zi clears Triple Burner Heat and conducts Heat downward. Together they treat Damp-Heat Lin and Heart Fire shifting to the Small Intestine.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱淋證、尿赤澀痛、口舌生瘡、煩躁、小便短赤；八正散/導赤散方向。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat Lin with red painful urination, mouth/tongue sores, irritability, and scanty red urine; Ba Zheng San / Dao Chi San direction.
pairs.caution_zh: 孕婦禁用川木通；津虧、陰虛、氣虛、陽虛、無濕熱者不宜。須避免誤用關木通。
pairs.caution_en: Chuan Mu Tong is contraindicated in pregnancy and unsuitable in fluid depletion, Yin/Qi/Yang deficiency, or absence of Damp-Heat. Avoid species confusion with Guan Mu Tong.

pairs.name_zh: 椿皮配黃柏、梔子、車前子
pairs.name_en: Chun Pi with Huang Bai, Zhi Zi, and Che Qian Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 椿皮苦寒收澀、清熱燥濕止帶；黃柏清下焦濕熱，梔子清熱導火下行，車前子利水滲濕。相使清下焦濕熱並收澀止帶。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chun Pi is bitter-cold and astringent, clearing Damp-Heat and stopping discharge; Huang Bai clears Lower Jiao Damp-Heat, Zhi Zi drains Heat downward, and Che Qian Zi promotes urination. Together they clear Lower Jiao Damp-Heat and secure discharge.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱赤白帶下、淋濁、帶下量多色黃或赤白相兼。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat red-white vaginal discharge, turbid Lin, or profuse yellow/red-white discharge.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、腎陰虛崩帶、瀉痢初起邪實未清者禁用/慎避；苦寒收澀不可誤留邪。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated/avoid in Spleen-Stomach deficiency-Cold, discharge/bleeding from Kidney Yin deficiency, or early dysentery with unresolved pathogen; bitter-cold astringents may trap pathogens.

pairs.name_en: Ci Wu Jia with Du Zhong and Sang Ji Sheng
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 刺五加益氣補腎、強筋骨；杜仲補肝腎強筋骨，桑寄生補肝腎、祛風濕。相使補腎強筋骨，兼顧久虛痹痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ci Wu Jia tonifies Qi/Kidney and strengthens sinews and bones; Du Zhong tonifies Liver/Kidney and strengthens bones; Sang Ji Sheng tonifies Liver/Kidney and dispels Wind-Damp. Together they support chronic deficiency Bi with weak low back and knees.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎虛腰膝痠痛、筋骨痿弱、久痹體虛疲倦。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney deficiency with low-back/knee soreness, weak sinews and bones, chronic Bi pain with fatigue.
pairs.caution_zh: 內熱、陰虛者禁用刺五加；若有實熱痹痛或濕熱未清，不宜單純補益。
pairs.caution_en: Ci Wu Jia is contraindicated in internal Heat or Yin deficiency; avoid a purely tonic strategy in Excess-Heat Bi or unresolved Damp-Heat.

pairs.actions_en: Ci Wu Jia tonifies Qi/Kidney and strengthens sinews and bones; Du Zhong tonifies Liver/Kidney and strengthens bones; Sang Ji Sheng tonifies Liver/Kidney and dispels Wind-Damp. Together they support chronic deficiency Bi with weak low back and knees.

pairs.name_zh: 沉香配丁香、白豆蔻、紫蘇葉、生薑
pairs.name_en: Chen Xiang with Ding Xiang, Bai Dou Kou, Zi Su Ye, and Sheng Jiang
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 沉香降逆納氣、溫中止嘔；丁香溫中降逆，白豆蔻芳香化濕醒脾，紫蘇葉行氣寬中，生薑溫胃止嘔。相使偏治寒濕或氣滯中焦所致嘔逆、脘腹脹滿。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chen Xiang descends rebellion, assists Qi grasping, and warms the Middle; Ding Xiang warms the Middle and descends rebellion, Bai Dou Kou aromatically transforms Dampness, Zi Su Ye moves Qi in the Middle, and Sheng Jiang warms the Stomach and stops vomiting. Together they address rebellious Stomach Qi from Cold-Damp or Qi stagnation.
pairs.indication_zh: 寒濕中阻或氣滯胃逆：嘔吐、呃逆、脘腹脹滿、胸膈痞悶。
pairs.indication_en: Cold-Damp obstruction or Qi stagnation with rebellious Stomach Qi: vomiting, hiccup, epigastric/abdominal distention, and chest/diaphragm oppression.
pairs.caution_zh: 此組多辛溫芳香，陰虛火旺、胃熱嘔吐、實熱或孕期使用沉香者需禁用/慎用並依來源辨證。
pairs.caution_en: This group is mostly acrid-warm and aromatic; avoid or use cautiously in Yin-deficiency Fire, Stomach-Heat vomiting, Excess Heat, or pregnancy when Chen Xiang is involved, according to source cautions and pattern differentiation.
pairs.actions_zh: 沉香降逆納氣、溫中止嘔；丁香溫中降逆，白豆蔻芳香化濕醒脾，紫蘇葉行氣寬中，生薑溫胃止嘔。相使偏治寒濕或氣滯中焦所致嘔逆、脘腹脹滿。

pairs.name_en: Chi Xiao Dou with Dang Gui
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 赤小豆利水退腫、解毒排膿；當歸養血活血，使利水解毒而不傷血，兼顧血分瘀滯與瘡瘍久腫。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Chi Xiao Dou drains water, reduces swelling, and resolves toxin/pus; Dang Gui nourishes and moves Blood, helping toxin-draining treatment avoid injuring Blood while addressing Blood-level stasis in chronic sores and swelling.
pairs.indication_zh: 瘡瘍腫毒、濕熱夾血瘀、久腫不消，或利水退腫時兼血虛血瘀者。
pairs.indication_en: Sores and toxic swellings, Damp-Heat with Blood stasis, persistent swelling, or edema patterns complicated by Blood deficiency or Blood stasis.
pairs.caution_zh: 無濕熱、無腫毒者不宜用赤小豆方向；便溏、出血傾向或抗凝/抗血小板用藥者用當歸須慎。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid a Chi Xiao Dou direction when Damp-Heat, swelling, or toxin is absent. Use Dang Gui cautiously in loose stools, bleeding tendency, or anticoagulant/antiplatelet use.

pairs.name_en: Di Fu Zi with Ku Shen and Bai Xian Pi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 地膚子利濕止癢，苦參苦寒燥濕殺蟲，白鮮皮清熱燥濕、祛風止癢。相使清濕熱、祛風止癢力強，適合濕熱皮膚瘙癢。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Di Fu Zi drains Dampness and stops itching; Ku Shen dries Dampness and kills parasites; Bai Xian Pi clears Damp-Heat and dispels Wind to stop itching. Together they strengthen Damp-Heat skin-pruritus treatment.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱皮膚瘙癢、濕疹、疥癬、陰部濕癢。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat pruritus, eczema, scabies, and genital itching.
pairs.caution_zh: 苦寒燥濕，脾胃虛寒、無濕熱者禁用/慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Bitter-cold and drying; avoid or use cautiously in Spleen-Stomach deficiency Cold or absence of Damp-Heat.

pairs.cautions_en: Bitter-cold and drying; avoid or use cautiously in Spleen-Stomach deficiency Cold or absence of Damp-Heat.

pairs.name_en: Di Fu Zi with Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 地膚子清膀胱濕熱、止癢通淋；車前子、滑石清利濕熱、利尿通淋。相使加強尿赤灼痛、濕熱下注之通利。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Di Fu Zi clears Bladder Damp-Heat and unblocks Lin; Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi clear Damp-Heat and promote urination. Together they strengthen treatment of hot painful urination and lower-Jiao Damp-Heat.
pairs.indication_zh: 膀胱濕熱淋證：尿赤澀痛、灼熱、小便短少。
pairs.indication_en: Bladder Damp-Heat Lin with red, painful, burning, scanty urination.
pairs.caution_zh: 無濕熱者不宜；脾胃虛寒或津液不足者慎用寒涼滲利。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable without Damp-Heat; use cold-draining diuretics cautiously in deficiency Cold or fluid depletion.

pairs.name_zh: 冬蟲夏草配杜仲、淫羊藿、肉蓯蓉
pairs.name_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao with Du Zhong, Yin Yang Huo, and Rou Cong Rong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬蟲夏草補腎益精、兼補肺；杜仲補肝腎強筋骨，淫羊藿溫腎助陽，肉蓯蓉補腎陽益精血。相使治腎虛陽弱、精虧筋骨不強。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao tonifies Kidney and Essence while supporting Lung; Du Zhong strengthens Liver/Kidney and bones, Yin Yang Huo warms Kidney Yang, and Rou Cong Rong tonifies Kidney Yang and Essence/Blood. Together they address Kidney Yang/Jing deficiency with weak bones and sexual dysfunction.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎虛陽痿、腰膝痠軟、筋骨無力、耳鳴、久虛疲倦。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney deficiency with impotence, weak low back/knees, weak sinews/bones, tinnitus, and chronic fatigue.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、實熱或表邪未解者慎避；冬蟲夏草表證慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Yin-deficiency Fire, Excess Heat, or unresolved exterior conditions; Cordyceps is cautioned in exterior conditions.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L124-L145

pairs.name_zh: 冬蟲夏草配川貝母、阿膠、麥門冬
pairs.name_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao with Chuan Bei Mu, E Jiao, and Mai Men Dong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬蟲夏草補肺腎、止血化痰；川貝母清潤化痰止咳，阿膠養血止血潤肺，麥冬養陰潤肺。相使治肺陰虛久咳、痰少血絲。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao tonifies Lung/Kidney and stops bleeding while transforming phlegm; Chuan Bei Mu moistens and transforms phlegm, E Jiao nourishes Blood and stops bleeding, and Mai Men Dong nourishes Lung Yin. Together they treat chronic Lung Yin deficiency cough with scanty blood-streaked sputum.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺陰虛久咳、乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、虛勞咳嗽。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic Lung Yin deficiency cough, dry cough with scant phlegm, blood-streaked sputum, and consumptive cough.
pairs.caution_zh: 痰濕壅盛或表邪未解者慎避；阿膠滋膩，脾胃虛弱便溏者慎。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously with unresolved exterior or abundant Phlegm-Damp; E Jiao is cloying and should be used cautiously in weak digestion or loose stools.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L124-L145

pairs.name_zh: 冬瓜子配魚腥草、蘆根、薏苡仁
pairs.name_en: Dong Gua Zi with Yu Xing Cao, Lu Gen, and Yi Yi Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬瓜子清熱化痰、消癰排膿；魚腥草清肺熱解毒排膿，蘆根清肺胃熱、生津，薏苡仁滲濕排膿。相使為肺癰痰熱膿痰方向。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Gua Zi clears Heat, transforms phlegm, and drains pus; Yu Xing Cao clears Lung Heat and drains pus, Lu Gen clears Lung/Stomach Heat and generates fluids, and Yi Yi Ren drains Dampness and pus. Together they address Lung abscess with Phlegm-Heat and purulent sputum.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺癰：咳吐腥臭膿痰、痰黃稠、胸痛、發熱。
pairs.indication_en: Lung abscess with foul-smelling purulent sputum, thick yellow phlegm, chest pain, and fever.
pairs.caution_zh: 寒痰咳嗽或脾胃虛寒便溏者慎；肺癰屬急重症，需醫療評估。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously in Cold-phlegm cough or deficiency-Cold loose stools; lung abscess is serious and requires medical evaluation.

pairs.name_zh: 冬瓜子配杏仁、半夏、川貝母、側柏葉
pairs.name_en: Dong Gua Zi with Xing Ren, Ban Xia, Chuan Bei Mu, and Ce Bai Ye
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬瓜子清熱化痰排膿；杏仁降肺氣止咳，半夏化痰，川貝母清潤化痰，側柏葉涼血止血。相使偏治痰熱/肺燥咳嗽兼血絲痰。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Gua Zi clears Heat and transforms phlegm/pus; Xing Ren descends Lung Qi, Ban Xia transforms phlegm, Chuan Bei Mu moistens and clears phlegm, and Ce Bai Ye cools Blood and stops bleeding. Together they address Phlegm-Heat or dry cough with blood-streaked sputum.
pairs.indication_zh: 支氣管炎、乾咳或痰少帶血、痰熱咳嗽兼肺絡受傷。
pairs.indication_en: Bronchitis, dry cough or scant blood-streaked sputum, and Phlegm-Heat cough with Lung vessel injury.
pairs.caution_zh: 半夏需炮製；陰虛燥咳與痰熱咳嗽需辨清，血痰需醫療評估。
pairs.caution_en: Ban Xia must be properly prepared; distinguish Yin-deficiency dry cough from Phlegm-Heat cough, and medically evaluate blood-streaked sputum.

pairs.name_zh: 冬葵子配車前子、滑石、金錢草
pairs.name_en: Dong Kui Zi with Che Qian Zi, Hua Shi, and Jin Qian Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬葵子滑利通淋兼潤腸；車前子、滑石清利濕熱，金錢草利濕排石。相使治濕熱石淋、尿痛兼便秘。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Kui Zi slippery-unblocks Lin and moistens the bowels; Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi clear Damp-Heat, and Jin Qian Cao drains Dampness and expels stones. Together they treat Damp-Heat Stone Lin with painful urination and constipation.
pairs.indication_zh: 石淋、熱淋、尿道澀痛、小便短赤，兼腸燥便秘。
pairs.indication_en: Stone Lin or Heat Lin with painful rough urination, scanty red urine, and dry constipation.
pairs.caution_zh: 孕期慎用；脾虛腸滑、便溏泄瀉、氣虛下陷者禁用/慎避。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously in pregnancy; avoid or use cautiously in Spleen deficiency slippery intestines, loose stools/diarrhea, or Qi sinking.
pairs.actions_zh: 冬葵子滑利通淋兼潤腸；車前子、滑石清利濕熱，金錢草利濕排石。相使治濕熱石淋、尿痛兼便秘。

pairs.name_en: Dong Kui Zi with Huo Ma Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬葵子滑利通便兼通淋，火麻仁潤腸通便。相使偏治腸液不足、大便乾結，尤其兼小便不利者。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Kui Zi slippery-unblocks the bowels and Lin; Huo Ma Ren moistens the intestines. Together they address dry constipation from intestinal fluid insufficiency, especially with difficult urination.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸燥便秘、津液不足、大便乾結，兼小便不利。
pairs.indication_en: Dry constipation from fluid insufficiency with hard stools, especially when accompanied by difficult urination.
pairs.caution_zh: 便溏、脾虛腸滑者禁用/慎用；孕期慎用冬葵子。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in loose stools or Spleen deficiency slippery intestines; use Dong Kui Zi cautiously in pregnancy.
pairs.actions_zh: 冬葵子滑利通便兼通淋，火麻仁潤腸通便。相使偏治腸液不足、大便乾結，尤其兼小便不利者。

pairs.indications_zh: 腸燥便秘、津液不足、大便乾結，兼小便不利。
pairs.indications_en: Dry constipation from fluid insufficiency with hard stools, especially when accompanied by difficult urination.
pairs.cautions_zh: 便溏、脾虛腸滑者禁用/慎用；孕期慎用冬葵子。
pairs.cautions_en: Avoid or use cautiously in loose stools or Spleen deficiency slippery intestines; use Dong Kui Zi cautiously in pregnancy.

pairs.name_en: Feng Mi with Bai Zi Ren and Huo Ma Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蜂蜜甘潤滑腸，柏子仁養心安神兼潤腸，火麻仁潤燥通便。相使治津虧腸燥便秘，兼心血不足不寐者尤合。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Honey sweetly moistens and lubricates the intestines; Bai Zi Ren nourishes Heart and moistens the bowels, and Huo Ma Ren moistens dryness and unblocks stool. Together they treat fluid-deficiency dry constipation, especially with Heart-Blood deficiency insomnia.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸燥便秘、大便乾結，兼心血不足、失眠心悸或年老津虧。
pairs.indication_en: Dry constipation with hard stools, especially in elder or fluid deficiency patterns with Heart-Blood deficiency insomnia or palpitations.
pairs.caution_zh: 痰濕中滿、便溏泄瀉者禁用/慎用；糖尿病與一歲以下嬰兒禁忌需單獨看蜂蜜安全欄。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Phlegm-Damp fullness or loose stools/diarrhea; diabetes and infant contraindications are listed under honey safety.

pairs.name_en: Feng Mi with Huang Qi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蜂蜜補中緩急、潤肺和藥；黃耆補氣升陽、固表。蜂蜜作蜜炙或同用可緩和藥性、增補中潤肺方向。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Honey tonifies the Middle, relaxes urgency, moistens the Lung, and harmonizes medicinals; Huang Qi tonifies Qi, raises Yang, and secures the exterior. Honey-frying or combining moderates and enhances Middle-tonifying and Lung-moistening effects.
pairs.indication_zh: 中氣不足疲倦、氣虛咳嗽、補氣方中需緩和藥性或蜜炙補中潤肺者。
pairs.indication_en: Middle Qi deficiency fatigue, Qi-deficiency cough, or formulas requiring honey-frying/harmonization to support the Middle and moisten the Lung.
pairs.caution_zh: 痰濕中滿、便溏者不宜蜂蜜；黃耆實邪未解、表實或陰虛陽亢者需辨證。
pairs.caution_en: Honey is unsuitable in Phlegm-Damp fullness or loose stools; Huang Qi requires differentiation in unresolved pathogen, exterior excess, or Yin deficiency with Yang rising.
pairs.actions_zh: 蜂蜜補中緩急、潤肺和藥；黃耆補氣升陽、固表。蜂蜜作蜜炙或同用可緩和藥性、增補中潤肺方向。
pairs.actions_en: Honey tonifies the Middle, relaxes urgency, moistens the Lung, and harmonizes medicinals; Huang Qi tonifies Qi, raises Yang, and secures the exterior. Honey-frying or combining moderates and enhances Middle-tonifying and Lung-moistening effects.
pairs.indications_zh: 中氣不足疲倦、氣虛咳嗽、補氣方中需緩和藥性或蜜炙補中潤肺者。
pairs.indications_en: Middle Qi deficiency fatigue, Qi-deficiency cough, or formulas requiring honey-frying/harmonization to support the Middle and moisten the Lung.

pairs.cautions_en: Honey is unsuitable in Phlegm-Damp fullness or loose stools; Huang Qi requires differentiation in unresolved pathogen, exterior excess, or Yin deficiency with Yang rising.

pairs.name_en: Di Fu Zi with Ku Shen and She Chuang Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 地膚子祛風除濕止癢，苦參清熱燥濕殺蟲，蛇床子燥濕祛風殺蟲止癢。相使外洗或內外合用，偏治濕熱或濕毒皮膚瘙癢、陰部濕癢。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Di Fu Zi dispels Wind-Damp and stops itching; Ku Shen clears and dries Damp-Heat and kills parasites; She Chuang Zi dries Dampness, dispels Wind, kills parasites, and stops itching. Together they are used internally or as a wash for Damp-Heat/Damp-toxin pruritus and genital itching.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱皮膚瘙癢、濕疹、疥癬、外陰或陰囊濕癢。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat pruritus, eczema, scabies, vulvar/genital or scrotal itching.
pairs.caution_zh: 苦寒與溫燥同用，需辨寒熱與濕熱/寒濕；脾胃虛寒或無濕熱者慎避。
pairs.caution_en: Combines bitter-cold and warm-drying strategies; differentiate Cold/Heat and Damp-Heat vs Cold-Damp. Use cautiously/avoid in deficiency Cold or absence of Damp-Heat.

pairs.name_zh: 地膚子配菊花、決明子、青葙子、穀精草
pairs.name_en: Di Fu Zi with Ju Hua, Jue Ming Zi, Qing Xiang Zi, and Gu Jing Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 地膚子兼清風熱頭目，菊花、決明子、青葙子、穀精草清肝明目。相使治風熱或肝熱目赤腫痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Di Fu Zi can clear Wind-Heat affecting the head and eyes; Ju Hua, Jue Ming Zi, Qing Xiang Zi, and Gu Jing Cao clear Liver/Wind-Heat and brighten the eyes. Together they address red, swollen, painful eyes from Wind-Heat or Liver Heat.
pairs.indication_zh: 風熱或肝熱目赤腫痛、頭面風熱。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Heat or Liver-Heat red, swollen, painful eyes and head/face Wind-Heat.
pairs.caution_zh: 寒涼清泄，脾胃虛寒者慎。`herb.qing_xiang_zi`、`herb.gu_jing_cao` 尚未建卡，之後補卡會自動恢復連結。
pairs.caution_en: Cold-clearing combination; use cautiously in Spleen-Stomach deficiency Cold. `herb.qing_xiang_zi` and `herb.gu_jing_cao` are pending local card creation.

pairs.actions_en: Di Fu Zi can clear Wind-Heat affecting the head and eyes; Ju Hua, Jue Ming Zi, Qing Xiang Zi, and Gu Jing Cao clear Liver/Wind-Heat and brighten the eyes. Together they address red, swollen, painful eyes from Wind-Heat or Liver Heat.

pairs.name_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao with Ge Jie
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬蟲夏草補肺腎、止血化痰，蛤蚧補肺腎、納氣定喘。相使治肺腎兩虛、腎不納氣之久咳虛喘；蛤蚧平喘力更強。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Chong Xia Cao tonifies Lung/Kidney and stops bleeding while transforming phlegm; Ge Jie tonifies Lung/Kidney and helps the Kidneys grasp Qi to calm wheezing. Together they treat chronic deficiency cough and wheezing from Lung-Kidney deficiency, with Ge Jie stronger for wheezing.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺腎兩虛久咳虛喘、腎不納氣、氣短喘促、痰少或血絲痰。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic Lung-Kidney deficiency cough/wheezing, failure of Kidneys to grasp Qi, shortness of breath, scant phlegm, or blood-streaked sputum.
pairs.caution_zh: 表邪未解、實熱咳喘或痰熱壅盛者慎避。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in unresolved exterior conditions, Excess-Heat cough/wheezing, or abundant Phlegm-Heat.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L124-L164

pairs.name_zh: 冬瓜子配杏仁、半夏、生地黃、南沙參、川貝母、側柏葉、茜草
pairs.name_en: Dong Gua Zi with Xing Ren, Ban Xia, Sheng Di Huang, Nan Sha Shen, Chuan Bei Mu, Ce Bai Ye, and Qian Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 冬瓜子清熱化痰、消癰排膿；杏仁降肺氣，半夏化痰，生地黃與南沙參養陰清熱，川貝母清潤化痰，側柏葉與茜草涼血止血。相使治乾咳或痰少帶血之肺熱/肺陰受傷。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Dong Gua Zi clears Heat and transforms phlegm/pus; Xing Ren descends Lung Qi, Ban Xia transforms phlegm, Sheng Di Huang and Nan Sha Shen nourish Yin and clear Heat, Chuan Bei Mu moistens and transforms phlegm, and Ce Bai Ye/Qian Cao cool Blood and stop bleeding. Together they address dry cough or scant blood-streaked sputum from Lung Heat or Lung Yin injury.
pairs.indication_zh: 乾咳、痰少、血絲痰、肺熱或肺陰受傷兼痰阻。
pairs.indication_en: Dry cough, scanty phlegm, blood-streaked sputum, Lung Heat or Lung Yin injury with phlegm obstruction.
pairs.caution_zh: 血痰需醫療評估；半夏必須炮製。
pairs.caution_en: Blood-streaked sputum needs medical evaluation; Ban Xia must be properly prepared.

pairs.name_zh: 覆盆子配桑螵蛸、益智仁
pairs.name_en: Fu Pen Zi with Sang Piao Xiao and Yi Zhi Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 覆盆子補腎固精縮尿，桑螵蛸補腎助陽固精，益智仁溫脾腎縮尿。三藥相使，強化下焦虛寒、腎不固攝之縮尿固精。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Pen Zi tonifies Kidney and secures essence/urine; Sang Piao Xiao supports Kidney Yang and secures essence; Yi Zhi Ren warms Spleen-Kidney and reduces urination. Together they strengthen lower-jiao astringing in deficiency-cold leakage.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎虛下元不固：遺尿、尿頻、夜尿多、遺精滑精。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney deficiency with lower-source insecurity: enuresis, urinary frequency, nocturia, spermatorrhea, or seminal emission.
pairs.caution_zh: 濕熱小便短赤、尿痛或陰虛火旺者慎避；不可只見尿頻就固澀。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Damp-Heat inhibited reddish urine, painful urination, or Yin-deficiency Fire; do not astringe urinary frequency blindly.

pairs.name_zh: 覆盆子配菟絲子、枸杞子、五味子
pairs.name_en: Fu Pen Zi with Tu Si Zi, Gou Qi Zi, and Wu Wei Zi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 覆盆子固腎明目，菟絲子補腎固精，枸杞子滋補肝腎明目，五味子收斂固澀。相使兼顧肝腎不足、精不固與目暗。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Fu Pen Zi secures Kidney and brightens the eyes; Tu Si Zi tonifies Kidney and secures essence; Gou Qi Zi nourishes Liver-Kidney and benefits vision; Wu Wei Zi astringes leakage. The combination addresses Liver-Kidney deficiency with essence leakage and visual decline.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝腎不足兼精關不固：視物昏花、腰膝痠軟、遺精、早洩或夢遺。
pairs.indication_en: Liver-Kidney deficiency with essence insecurity: blurred vision, low-back/knee soreness, spermatorrhea, premature ejaculation, or wet dreams.
pairs.caution_zh: 有實熱、濕熱尿痛或陰虛火旺明顯者慎避；枸杞滋膩，脾虛濕重需辨。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Excess Heat, Damp-Heat painful urination, or marked Yin-deficiency Fire; Gou Qi Zi can be cloying in Spleen deficiency with Dampness.
pairs.actions_zh: 覆盆子固腎明目，菟絲子補腎固精，枸杞子滋補肝腎明目，五味子收斂固澀。相使兼顧肝腎不足、精不固與目暗。

pairs.name_en: Ge Jie with Ren Shen
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蛤蚧補肺腎、納氣定喘；人參大補元氣、補肺氣。相使恢復肺腎相生，治肺腎兩虛、腎不納氣之虛喘。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ge Jie tonifies Lung-Kidney and helps the Kidneys grasp Qi; Ren Shen powerfully tonifies source and Lung Qi. Together they restore Lung-Kidney support for deficiency wheezing.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺腎兩虛、腎不納氣：久喘、動則喘甚、氣短乏力、聲低懶言。
pairs.indication_en: Lung-Kidney deficiency with failure of the Kidneys to grasp Qi: chronic wheezing worse on exertion, shortness of breath, fatigue, and weak voice.
pairs.caution_zh: 外感未解、表證咳喘、實熱或痰熱壅盛者不宜；人參實證、熱盛者亦須辨。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable in unresolved exterior cough/wheezing, Excess Heat, or exuberant Phlegm-Heat; also differentiate Ren Shen use in excess or Heat patterns.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L147-L165

pairs.name_zh: 蛤蚧配人參、杏仁、川貝母
pairs.name_en: Ge Jie with Ren Shen, Xing Ren, and Chuan Bei Mu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蛤蚧補肺腎納氣，人參補肺氣，杏仁降肺氣止咳喘，川貝母潤肺化痰。相使於虛中夾痰之久咳喘。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ge Jie supports Lung-Kidney grasping of Qi, Ren Shen tonifies Lung Qi, Xing Ren descends Lung Qi, and Chuan Bei Mu moistens Lung and transforms phlegm. Together they address chronic deficiency cough/wheezing with phlegm.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺腎兩虛久咳虛喘，兼痰少或痰黏、咳嗽日久、氣短。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic Lung-Kidney deficiency cough/wheezing with scant or sticky phlegm, long-standing cough, and shortness of breath.
pairs.caution_zh: 痰熱實盛、外感初起或黃稠痰多者慎避；川貝母寒潤，脾胃虛寒需辨。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in exuberant Phlegm-Heat, early exterior invasion, or copious thick yellow phlegm; Chuan Bei Mu is cold-moistening and requires Spleen-Stomach differentiation.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L147-L165

pairs.name_en: Gou Ji with Du Zhong and Niu Xi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 狗脊補肝腎、祛風濕，杜仲補肝腎強腰膝，牛膝補肝腎並引血下行、利關節。相使加強腰膝痠痛、下肢無力之補肝腎通痹。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gou Ji tonifies Liver-Kidney and dispels Wind-Damp; Du Zhong strengthens low back and knees; Niu Xi tonifies Liver-Kidney, benefits joints, and guides downward. Together they support deficiency low-back/knee Bi.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝腎不足兼風寒濕痹：腰膝痠痛、脊背僵硬、下肢無力或麻木。
pairs.indication_en: Liver-Kidney deficiency with Wind-Cold-Damp Bi: low-back/knee soreness, spinal stiffness, lower-limb weakness, or numbness.
pairs.caution_zh: 濕熱痹、熱性小便不利或陰虛火旺者慎避；牛膝活血下行，孕期需辨。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Damp-Heat Bi, Heat-type difficult urination, or Yin-deficiency Fire; Niu Xi moves Blood downward and pregnancy requires differentiation.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L320-L343

pairs.cautions_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Damp-Heat Bi, Heat-type difficult urination, or Yin-deficiency Fire; Niu Xi moves Blood downward and pregnancy requires differentiation.

pairs.name_en: Gou Ji with Du Zhong and Xu Duan
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 狗脊、杜仲、續斷皆補肝腎強筋骨；續斷另有續筋骨、止血安胎方向。相須強化肝腎不足腰膝痠痛與筋骨不健。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gou Ji, Du Zhong, and Xu Duan all tonify Liver-Kidney and strengthen sinews/bones; Xu Duan also reconnects sinews/bones and has bleeding/pregnancy-support directions. Together they mutually reinforce deficiency low-back/knee support.
pairs.indication_zh: 肝腎不足腰膝痠痛、筋骨痿弱、慢性腰背痛。
pairs.indication_en: Liver-Kidney deficiency with low-back/knee soreness, sinew-bone weakness, and chronic low-back pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 小便不利屬熱、陰虛火旺或濕熱者慎避；續斷安胎方向需與孕期辨證分開核對。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Heat-type difficult urination, Yin-deficiency Fire, or Damp-Heat; Xu Duan pregnancy-support use still requires pregnancy pattern differentiation.

pairs.name_zh: 狗脊配桂枝、秦艽、木瓜、五加皮
pairs.name_en: Gou Ji with Gui Zhi, Qin Jiao, Mu Gua, and Wu Jia Pi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 狗脊補肝腎兼祛風濕，桂枝溫通經脈，秦艽舒筋祛風濕，木瓜舒筋化濕，五加皮祛風濕強筋骨。相使治虛中夾風寒濕痹。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gou Ji tonifies Liver-Kidney and dispels Wind-Damp; Gui Zhi warms and unblocks channels; Qin Jiao, Mu Gua, and Wu Jia Pi dispel Wind-Damp and relax/strengthen sinews. Together they treat deficiency with Wind-Cold-Damp Bi.
pairs.indication_zh: 風寒濕痹、慢性筋骨痹痛：腰腿酸痛、肢體麻木、筋脈拘急，兼肝腎不足者。
pairs.indication_en: Wind-Cold-Damp Bi and chronic sinew-bone pain: low-back/leg soreness, limb numbness, and sinew contracture with underlying Liver-Kidney deficiency.
pairs.caution_zh: 熱痹、陰虛內熱或小便短赤者慎避；溫通祛風濕藥較多，需辨寒熱虛實。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in Heat Bi, Yin-deficiency internal Heat, or short reddish urination; the warming Wind-Damp strategy requires cold/heat and excess/deficiency differentiation.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L331-L343

pairs.name_en: Gu Sui Bu with Ru Xiang and Mo Yao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 骨碎補補腎接骨，乳香、沒藥活血止痛、消腫生肌。相使治跌打骨折、瘀血腫痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gu Sui Bu tonifies Kidney and mends fractures; Ru Xiang and Mo Yao invigorate Blood, relieve pain, reduce swelling, and support tissue repair. Together they treat traumatic fractures and Blood-stasis swelling/pain.
pairs.indication_zh: 跌打損傷、骨折、瘀血腫痛、扭挫傷。
pairs.indication_en: Traumatic injury, fractures, Blood-stasis swelling/pain, sprains, and contusions.
pairs.caution_zh: 孕期、出血風險或無瘀血者慎用；陰虛血虛有熱者不宜硬用溫性活血接骨。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously in pregnancy, bleeding risk, or absence of Blood stasis; avoid forcing a warm Blood-moving fracture strategy in Yin/Blood deficiency with Heat.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III - Yang Tonics Full.md#L344-L366

pairs.name_en: Gu Sui Bu with Xu Duan
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 骨碎補補腎強骨、活血接骨，續斷補肝腎、續筋骨。相須強化骨折、筋傷、腰膝痠痛之續傷接骨。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gu Sui Bu tonifies Kidney, strengthens bone, invigorates Blood, and mends fractures; Xu Duan tonifies Liver-Kidney and reconnects sinews/bones. Together they mutually reinforce fracture and sinew-injury repair.
pairs.indication_zh: 跌打損傷、骨折筋傷、腰膝痠痛、筋骨痿弱。
pairs.indication_en: Traumatic injury, fractures, tendon injury, low-back/knee soreness, and sinew-bone weakness.
pairs.caution_zh: 無瘀血、陰虛血虛有熱者慎避；活血續傷方向不等於所有骨痛皆可用。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously when there is no Blood stasis or when Yin/Blood deficiency with Heat is present; a bone-healing strategy is not appropriate for every type of bone pain.

pairs.name_en: Gu Ya with Mai Ya
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 谷芽、麥芽皆消穀麥澱粉食積；谷芽較溫和健胃，麥芽消食力強且另有回乳方向。相須加強米麵穀物積滯與開胃。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gu Ya and Mai Ya both reduce grain/starch food stagnation; Gu Ya is gentler and strengthens the Stomach, while Mai Ya is stronger and also has a lactation-inhibiting direction. Together they reinforce digestion of grains and starches.
pairs.indication_zh: 米麵穀物食積、消化不良、脘腹脹滿、食慾不振。
pairs.indication_en: Rice/noodle/grain food stagnation, indigestion, epigastric/abdominal fullness, and poor appetite.
pairs.caution_zh: 哺乳期需維持乳汁者慎避，尤其麥芽/谷芽來源皆有回乳或哺乳禁忌相關記載。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously in lactation when milk supply should be maintained, especially because Mai Ya and AD’s Gu Ya page involve lactation-related cautions.

pairs.name_en: Gu Ya with Shan Zha and Shen Qu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 谷芽消米麵穀物，山楂消肉食油膩，神麴消酒食陳腐積滯。相使擴大食積類型，適合飲食不節、食滯夾雜。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gu Ya digests grains/starches, Shan Zha digests meat/greasy foods, and Shen Qu addresses fermented/alcohol/complex food accumulation. Together they broaden food-stagnation coverage.
pairs.indication_zh: 飲食不節、食積夾雜：腹脹、噯腐吞酸、食後不舒、納呆。
pairs.indication_en: Mixed food stagnation from dietary irregularity: abdominal fullness, foul belching, acid regurgitation, postprandial discomfort, and poor appetite.
pairs.caution_zh: 無食積者不宜；脾胃虛弱者宜配健脾藥，不可單純攻消太過。
pairs.caution_en: Unsuitable without food stagnation; in Spleen-Stomach deficiency, combine with Spleen-strengthening herbs and avoid excessive reducing.

pairs.name_en: Gua Lou Pi with Huang Lian and Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 栝樓皮清肺化痰、寬胸散結，黃連清熱燥濕瀉火，半夏化痰降逆。相使清化痰熱、開胸除滿，為小陷胸湯核心意。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gua Lou Pi clears Lung Heat, transforms Phlegm, and opens the chest; Huang Lian clears Heat and drains Fire; Ban Xia transforms Phlegm and directs rebellion downward. Together they clear Phlegm-Heat and relieve chest fullness, echoing Xiao Xian Xiong Tang.
pairs.indication_zh: 痰熱胸痺、胸悶胸痛、咳嗽痰黃黏稠。
pairs.indication_en: Chest Bi from Phlegm-Heat with chest oppression/pain and cough with yellow sticky sputum.
pairs.caution_zh: 寒痰、濕痰或脾胃虛寒泄瀉者忌用；栝樓類反烏頭。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Cold-Phlegm, Damp-Phlegm, or Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold diarrhea; Gua Lou-type herbs are incompatible with Wu Tou.

pairs.name_en: Gua Lou Pi with Xie Bai and Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 栝樓皮寬胸化痰，薤白通陽散結，半夏燥濕化痰、降逆除滿。相使開胸通陽、化痰散結。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gua Lou Pi opens the chest and transforms Phlegm; Xie Bai unblocks Yang and disperses clumping; Ban Xia dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, and relieves fullness. Together they open the chest, unblock Yang, and transform clumped Phlegm.
pairs.indication_zh: 胸陽不振或寒濕痰阻上焦之胸痺、胸悶、氣短、咳痰。
pairs.indication_en: Chest Bi with chest oppression, shortness of breath, and sputum due to chest Yang obstruction or Cold-Damp Phlegm in the upper jiao.
pairs.caution_zh: 此配伍處理寒濕胸痺時須辨熱寒；若純寒痰濕而無配伍轉化，不可單用栝樓清寒之性。
pairs.caution_en: Differentiate Cold-Damp chest Bi from Phlegm-Heat; do not use Gua Lou's cold nature alone in untransformed Cold-Damp Phlegm.
pairs.actions_zh: 栝樓皮寬胸化痰，薤白通陽散結，半夏燥濕化痰、降逆除滿。相使開胸通陽、化痰散結。

pairs.indications_en: Chest Bi with chest oppression, shortness of breath, and sputum due to chest Yang obstruction or Cold-Damp Phlegm in the upper jiao.
pairs.cautions_zh: 此配伍處理寒濕胸痺時須辨熱寒；若純寒痰濕而無配伍轉化，不可單用栝樓清寒之性。
pairs.cautions_en: Differentiate Cold-Damp chest Bi from Phlegm-Heat; do not use Gua Lou's cold nature alone in untransformed Cold-Damp Phlegm.

pairs.name_zh: 栝樓皮配貝母、桔梗、杏仁
pairs.name_en: Gua Lou Pi with Bei Mu, Jie Geng, and Xing Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 栝樓皮清肺化痰，貝母清熱化痰散結，桔梗宣肺利咽載藥上行，杏仁降肺氣止咳。相使清化痰熱、宣降肺氣。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gua Lou Pi clears Lung Heat and transforms Phlegm; Bei Mu clears Heat, transforms Phlegm, and disperses clumping; Jie Geng disseminates Lung Qi and guides upward; Xing Ren directs Lung Qi downward and stops cough. Together they clear Phlegm-Heat and restore Lung diffusion/descent.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺熱痰黃黏稠、咳嗽、咽乾、痰難咯。
pairs.indication_en: Lung-Heat cough with yellow sticky sputum, dry throat, and difficult expectoration.
pairs.caution_zh: AD 原文列 Bei Mu 泛稱；本地先連到浙貝母以符合痰熱散結語境，需人工確認是否另建泛稱連結。
pairs.caution_en: American Dragon lists Bei Mu generically; this local record links Zhe Bei Mu for the Phlegm-Heat clumping context and should be manually confirmed.

pairs.name_en: Gua Lou Ren with Huo Ma Ren and Zhi Ke
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 栝樓仁潤肺滑腸，火麻仁潤腸通便，枳殼行氣寬中。相使潤腸而不滯，適合燥結兼氣機不暢。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gua Lou Ren moistens Lung and lubricates the Intestines; Huo Ma Ren moistens the Intestines and unblocks stool; Zhi Ke moves Qi and relaxes the middle. Together they moisten without cloying and address Dryness constipation with Qi constraint.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸燥便秘、大便乾結、胸腹氣滯不暢。
pairs.indication_en: Intestinal-Dryness constipation, dry stool, and chest/abdominal Qi stagnation.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾虛便溏、泄瀉者忌用；栝樓仁過量易腹瀉。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Spleen deficiency loose stool or diarrhea; Gua Lou Ren overdose may cause diarrhea.

pairs.name_en: Gua Lou Ren with Xing Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 栝樓仁潤肺化痰，杏仁降肺氣止咳。相使一潤一降，用於肺燥痰少難咯之咳嗽。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gua Lou Ren moistens the Lung and transforms Phlegm; Xing Ren directs Lung Qi downward and stops cough. Together they moisten and descend Lung Qi for dry cough with scant difficult sputum.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺燥乾咳、痰少黏稠、咯痰不爽。
pairs.indication_en: Lung-Dryness dry cough with scant sticky sputum and difficult expectoration.
pairs.caution_zh: 痰寒、痰濕或便溏泄瀉者忌用；杏仁用量另需依毒性規範審核。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Cold-Phlegm, Damp-Phlegm, or loose stool/diarrhea; Xing Ren dose also requires toxicity-aware review.
pairs.actions_zh: 栝樓仁潤肺化痰，杏仁降肺氣止咳。相使一潤一降，用於肺燥痰少難咯之咳嗽。
pairs.actions_en: Gua Lou Ren moistens the Lung and transforms Phlegm; Xing Ren directs Lung Qi downward and stops cough. Together they moisten and descend Lung Qi for dry cough with scant difficult sputum.
pairs.indications_zh: 肺燥乾咳、痰少黏稠、咯痰不爽。
pairs.indications_en: Lung-Dryness dry cough with scant sticky sputum and difficult expectoration.
pairs.cautions_zh: 痰寒、痰濕或便溏泄瀉者忌用；杏仁用量另需依毒性規範審核。
pairs.cautions_en: Avoid in Cold-Phlegm, Damp-Phlegm, or loose stool/diarrhea; Xing Ren dose also requires toxicity-aware review.

pairs.name_zh: 海螵蛸配山藥、龍骨、牡蠣
pairs.name_en: Hai Piao Xiao with Shan Yao, Long Gu, and Mu Li
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 海螵蛸收澀止帶固精，山藥補脾腎而固澀，龍骨、牡蠣重鎮收斂。相使加強久漏久帶、精關不固之收攝力。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hai Piao Xiao astringes discharge and secures Jing; Shan Yao tonifies Spleen-Kidney and stabilizes; Long Gu and Mu Li heavily anchor and astringe. Together they strengthen containment for chronic leakage/discharge and insecure Jing.
pairs.indication_zh: 久帶不止、遺精滑精、虛性漏下。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic vaginal discharge, seminal emission/spermatorrhea, and deficiency-type leakage.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛有熱、血熱或孕期禁用；久服可致便秘。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in deficiency Heat, Blood Heat, or pregnancy; long-term use may cause constipation.

pairs.name_en: Hai Piao Xiao with Bai Ji
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: AD 配伍例中見海螵蛸與白及用於收斂止血；但同頁禁忌/相惡又列白及，CloudTCM 也列白及相剋。此組只作來源差異審核記錄。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: American Dragon lists Hai Piao Xiao with Bai Ji in hemostatic combinations, while the same page and CloudTCM also list Bai Ji as antagonistic/incompatible. This record is kept only as a source-conflict review item.
pairs.indication_zh: 吐血、咯血、外傷出血等收斂止血語境，需人工確認。
pairs.indication_en: Hematemesis, hemoptysis, or traumatic bleeding contexts requiring manual confirmation.
pairs.caution_zh: 來源衝突：AD/CloudTCM 均有白及相惡/相剋警示；未經人工確認不可當作推薦對藥。

pairs.name_en: Hai Tong Pi with Niu Xi and Qiang Huo
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 海桐皮祛風濕通絡，牛膝引血下行、強腰膝，羌活祛風寒濕止痛。相使治久痹偏腰膝下肢。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hai Tong Pi dispels Wind-Damp and unblocks the channels; Niu Xi guides downward and strengthens the low back/knees; Qiang Huo dispels Wind-Cold-Damp and relieves pain. Together they address chronic Bi focused in the low back, knees, and lower limbs.
pairs.indication_zh: 久痹、風寒濕痹、腰膝痠痛、下肢疼痛。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic Bi, Wind-Cold-Damp Bi, low-back and knee soreness/pain, and lower-limb pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 無風濕、血虛或積熱火盛者忌用；孕期慎用活血通絡方向。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid when Wind-Dampness is absent, in Blood deficiency, or in accumulated Fire; use Blood-moving/channel-opening strategies cautiously in pregnancy.

pairs.name_en: Hai Tong Pi with Bi Xie and Mu Tong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 海桐皮祛風濕通絡，萆薢分清化濁、祛濕，木通清利濕熱通淋。相使處理濕熱下注兼膝腿熱痛。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hai Tong Pi dispels Wind-Damp and unblocks collaterals; Bi Xie separates the clear from the turbid and drains Dampness; Mu Tong clears and drains Damp-Heat. Together they treat Damp-Heat pouring downward with heat and pain of the knees/legs.
pairs.indication_zh: 濕熱下注、膝腿熱痛、下肢痹痛兼小便不利。
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Heat pouring downward with heat/pain in the knees or legs and lower-limb Bi pain with inhibited urination.
pairs.caution_zh: 木通類須注意來源品種與腎毒性審核；血虛或無風濕者不宜。
pairs.caution_en: Mu Tong-type herbs require species and nephrotoxicity review; avoid in Blood deficiency or absence of Wind-Dampness.

pairs.name_en: Hai Zao with Kun Bu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 海藻、昆布皆鹹寒，消痰軟堅、散結消癭。相須加強癭瘤、瘰癧、痰核硬結之軟堅散結力。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hai Zao and Kun Bu are both salty and cold; both transform Phlegm, soften hardness, and disperse goiter/nodules. Together they mutually reinforce softening and dispersing for goiter, scrofula, and hard Phlegm nodules.
pairs.indication_zh: 癭瘤、瘰癧、頸項痰核、痰結硬塊。
pairs.indication_en: Goiter, scrofula, neck Phlegm nodules, and hard Phlegm clumps.
pairs.caution_zh: 海藻反甘草；昆布卡片尚待建立，先保留未連結 ID。脾胃虛寒者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Hai Zao is incompatible with Gan Cao; the Kun Bu card is pending creation, so its ID is intentionally retained as an unlinked reference. Avoid in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold.
sources: curriculum/herbs/Materia Medica III-Herbs that Transform Phlegm.md#L389-L536

pairs.name_en: He Tao Ren with Du Zhong and Bu Gu Zhi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 核桃仁補腎益精、強腰膝，杜仲補肝腎強筋骨，補骨脂溫補腎陽。相使溫補腎陽、強腰膝並助納氣。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: He Tao Ren tonifies Kidney and Jing and strengthens the low back/knees; Du Zhong tonifies Liver-Kidney and strengthens sinews/bones; Bu Gu Zhi warms Kidney Yang. Together they enhance Kidney Yang, low-back/knee strength, and Qi grasping.
pairs.indication_zh: 腎陽不足之腰膝冷痛、下肢無力，兼咳喘或早洩尿頻。
pairs.indication_en: Kidney Yang deficiency with cold painful low back/knees, weak legs, and possible cough/wheezing, premature ejaculation, or urinary frequency.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛火旺、熱咳、痰火或便溏泄瀉者忌用；核桃仁有抗凝/抗血小板交互作用需審核。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Yin deficiency Heat, Hot cough, Phlegm-Fire, or loose stool/diarrhea; review He Tao Ren anticoagulant/antiplatelet interactions.

pairs.cautions_en: Avoid in Yin deficiency Heat, Hot cough, Phlegm-Fire, or loose stool/diarrhea; review He Tao Ren anticoagulant/antiplatelet interactions.

pairs.name_en: He Tao Ren with Ren Shen and Ge Jie
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 核桃仁溫肺補腎納氣，人參補肺脾元氣，蛤蚧補肺腎定喘。相使補肺腎、納氣平喘。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: He Tao Ren warms Lung-Kidney and helps grasp Qi; Ren Shen tonifies Lung/Spleen Yuan Qi; Ge Jie tonifies Lung-Kidney and calms wheezing. Together they tonify Lung-Kidney and relieve dyspnea.
pairs.indication_zh: 肺腎兩虛、腎不納氣之久咳久喘、動則喘甚、不能平臥。
pairs.indication_en: Chronic cough and wheezing from Lung-Kidney deficiency or Kidneys failing to grasp Qi, worse on exertion and possibly inability to lie flat.
pairs.caution_zh: 有熱咳、痰火、外邪未解或出血/抗凝藥風險者慎用或禁用。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid or use cautiously with Hot cough, Phlegm-Fire, unresolved exterior pathogen, or bleeding/anticoagulant risk.

pairs.name_zh: 核桃仁配當歸、火麻仁、肉蓯蓉
pairs.name_en: He Tao Ren with Dang Gui, Huo Ma Ren, and Rou Cong Rong
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 核桃仁與火麻仁潤腸，當歸養血潤燥，肉蓯蓉溫補腎陽而潤腸。相使治津血不足或老年虛弱便秘。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: He Tao Ren and Huo Ma Ren moisten the Intestines; Dang Gui nourishes Blood and moistens Dryness; Rou Cong Rong warms Kidney Yang while moistening the bowels. Together they address deficiency constipation, especially in the elderly.
pairs.indication_zh: 津血不足、腎虛或老年腸燥便秘。
pairs.indication_en: Intestinal Dryness constipation from deficient Fluids/Blood, Kidney deficiency, or old age.
pairs.caution_zh: 便溏泄瀉、水樣便或濕盛者忌用；孕期與抗凝藥風險需審核。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in loose stool, watery diarrhea, or pronounced Dampness; review pregnancy and anticoagulant risk.

pairs.name_en: Hu Jiao with Gao Liang Jiang and Bi Ba
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 胡椒辛熱溫中，高良薑溫胃止嘔，蓽茇溫中下氣止痛。相使溫散胃腸寒邪、止痛止嘔止瀉。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hu Jiao is acrid-hot and warms the middle; Gao Liang Jiang warms the Stomach and stops vomiting; Bi Ba warms the middle, descends Qi, and relieves pain. Together they disperse Cold in the Stomach/Intestines and stop pain, vomiting, and diarrhea.
pairs.indication_zh: 胃腸寒冷之嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛、脘腹冷痛。
pairs.indication_en: Stomach/Intestinal Cold with vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and cold epigastric pain.
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛有熱、實熱、孕期、出血、痔瘡、咽喉口齒目疾者忌用。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in Yin deficiency Heat, Excess Heat, pregnancy, bleeding, hemorrhoids, or throat/mouth/tooth/eye disorders.

pairs.name_en: Hu Jiao with Sheng Jiang and Ban Xia
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 胡椒溫中下氣，生薑溫胃散寒止嘔，半夏燥濕化痰降逆。相使治胃寒痰飲上逆之劇烈嘔吐。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Hu Jiao warms the middle and descends Qi; Sheng Jiang warms the Stomach, disperses Cold, and stops vomiting; Ban Xia dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, and directs rebellion downward. Together they treat severe vomiting from Stomach Cold with Phlegm-fluid rebellion.
pairs.indication_zh: 胃寒劇烈嘔吐、清水嘔吐、痰飲上逆。
pairs.indication_en: Severe vomiting, vomiting of clear fluid, and Phlegm-fluid rebellion due to Stomach Cold.
pairs.caution_zh: 熱嘔、陰虛火旺、孕期或咽喉口齒目疾者忌用；半夏需炮製。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid in Heat vomiting, Yin deficiency with Fire, pregnancy, or throat/mouth/tooth/eye disorders; Ban Xia must be properly processed.

pairs.name_en: Di Yu with Huai Mi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 地榆涼血止血、解毒斂瘡，槐米涼血止血、清肝降火。相須治大腸濕熱/血熱出血，尤其便血痔血。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Di Yu cools Blood, stops bleeding, resolves toxin, and astringes sores; Huai Mi cools Blood, stops bleeding, cools Liver, and drains Fire. Together they mutually reinforce treatment of Large Intestine Damp-Heat/Blood-Heat bleeding, especially blood in stool and bleeding hemorrhoids.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸風便血、痔血、血痢、熱性崩漏或子宮出血。
pairs.indication_en: Intestinal Wind bleeding, bleeding hemorrhoids, bloody dysentery, and Heat-type uterine bleeding.
pairs.caution_zh: NCBAHM 2026 CH Appendix B 明列。脾胃虛寒或脾氣虛不攝血者慎用；陰虛血熱/非實熱禁用槐米。
pairs.caution_en: Listed in NCBAHM 2026 CH Appendix B. Use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold or Spleen Qi failing to contain Blood; Huai Mi is contraindicated in Yin-deficiency Blood Heat or non-Excess Heat.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

Together they mutually reinforce treatment of Large Intestine Damp-Heat/Blood-Heat bleeding, especially blood in stool and bleeding hemorrhoids.

pairs.indications_en: Intestinal Wind bleeding, bleeding hemorrhoids, bloody dysentery, and Heat-type uterine bleeding.
pairs.cautions_zh: NCBAHM 2026 CH Appendix B 明列。脾胃虛寒或脾氣虛不攝血者慎用；陰虛血熱/非實熱禁用槐米。
pairs.cautions_en: Listed in NCBAHM 2026 CH Appendix B. Use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold or Spleen Qi failing to contain Blood; Huai Mi is contraindicated in Yin-deficiency Blood Heat or non-Excess Heat.

pairs.name_zh: 槐米配側柏葉、荊芥、枳殼
pairs.name_en: Huai Mi with Ce Bai Ye, Jing Jie, and Zhi Ke
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 槐米涼血止血，側柏葉涼血收斂止血，荊芥穗疏風止血，枳殼行氣寬腸。相使治腸風痔血，為槐花散意。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Huai Mi cools Blood and stops bleeding; Ce Bai Ye cools and astringes Blood; Jing Jie Sui dispels Wind and stops bleeding; Zhi Ke moves Qi and relaxes the Intestines. Together they treat Intestinal Wind bleeding and bleeding hemorrhoids, echoing Huai Hua San.
pairs.indication_zh: 腸風便血、痔瘡出血、血痢。
pairs.indication_en: Intestinal Wind bleeding, bleeding hemorrhoids, and bloody dysentery.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、脾氣虛不攝血者慎用；需辨血熱濕熱與虛寒出血。
pairs.caution_en: Use cautiously in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold or Spleen Qi failing to contain Blood; distinguish Blood-Heat/Damp-Heat bleeding from deficiency-cold bleeding.

pairs.name_en: Jin Ying Zi with Sang Piao Xiao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 金櫻子收澀固精縮尿，桑螵蛸補腎助陽、固精縮尿。相使治腎虛下焦不固。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jin Ying Zi astringes Jing and urine; Sang Piao Xiao tonifies Kidney Yang and secures Jing/urine. Together they treat Kidney deficiency lower-jiao instability.
pairs.indication_zh: 遺精、遺尿、尿頻、老年小便失禁。
pairs.indication_en: Spermatorrhea, enuresis, urinary frequency, and elderly urinary incontinence.
pairs.caution_zh: 實邪、熱邪或陰虛火旺之滑脫禁用；金櫻子只收不補，虛證需配補藥。
pairs.caution_en: Contraindicated in excess pathogens, Heat, or Yin-deficiency Fire leakage; Jin Ying Zi only astringes and does not tonify, so deficiency requires tonics.

pairs.name_en: Jin Ying Zi with Qian Shi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 金櫻子收澀下焦，芡實益腎固精、補脾止瀉。相使治腎虛滑脫與脾虛久瀉。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Jin Ying Zi astringes the lower jiao; Qian Shi tonifies Kidney, secures Jing, strengthens Spleen, and stops diarrhea. Together they treat Kidney deficiency leakage and Spleen deficiency chronic diarrhea.
pairs.indication_zh: 遺精、尿頻、帶下、脾虛久瀉。
pairs.indication_en: Spermatorrhea, urinary frequency, vaginal discharge, and chronic Spleen deficiency diarrhea.
pairs.caution_zh: 實熱、濕熱或邪未去者不宜收澀；便秘腹痛者慎用。
pairs.caution_en: Do not astringe when Excess Heat, Damp-Heat, or unresolved pathogens remain; use cautiously with constipation or abdominal pain.
pairs.actions_zh: 金櫻子收澀下焦，芡實益腎固精、補脾止瀉。相使治腎虛滑脫與脾虛久瀉。

pairs.name_en: Jing Mi with Shi Gao, Zhi Mu, and Gan Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 石膏、知母清氣分大熱，粳米、甘草益胃生津、緩和寒涼。相使清熱而護胃津，為白虎湯核心結構。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Shi Gao and Zhi Mu clear blazing Qi-level Heat; Jing Mi and Gan Cao support the Stomach, generate fluids, and moderate coldness. Together they clear Heat while protecting Stomach fluids, the core structure of Bai Hu Tang.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣分大熱、壯熱煩渴、大汗、脈洪大，兼胃津受傷風險。
pairs.indication_en: Blazing Qi-level Heat with high fever, irritability, thirst, profuse sweating, a flooding pulse, and risk of Stomach-fluid injury.
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒、無實熱者不宜用白虎湯清寒結構；粳米本身是護胃佐使，不代表可忽略石膏知母寒性。
pairs.caution_en: Avoid the cold Bai Hu Tang structure in Spleen/Stomach deficiency-cold or absence of excess Heat; Jing Mi protects the Stomach but does not cancel Shi Gao/Zhi Mu coldness.
pairs.actions_zh: 石膏、知母清氣分大熱，粳米、甘草益胃生津、緩和寒涼。相使清熱而護胃津，為白虎湯核心結構。

pairs.name_en: Ling Zhi with Suan Zao Ren
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 靈芝補氣安神，酸棗仁養心陰、斂心汗、安神。兩藥相須，補氣與養陰並行，加強安神助眠之力，尤適合氣虛兼陰血不足之失眠。American Dragon 註明柏子仁可作替代/並用選擇。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ling Zhi tonifies Qi and calms the Shen; Suan Zao Ren nourishes Heart Yin and calms the Shen. Used together they mutually reinforce both Qi- and Yin-nourishing calming action, especially for insomnia from combined Qi deficiency and Yin-Blood insufficiency. American Dragon notes Bai Zi Ren as an interchangeable/adjunct option in the same combination.
pairs.indication_zh: 氣虛兼陰血不足之失眠、心悸、健忘
pairs.indication_en: Insomnia, palpitations, and forgetfulness from combined Qi deficiency and Yin-Blood insufficiency
pairs.caution_zh: 實邪內盛者不宜單用補法；柏子仁可視體質替換或並用。
pairs.caution_en: Not appropriate as sole treatment when Excess pathogens are present; Bai Zi Ren may substitute or be added depending on constitution.

pairs.name_en: She Chuang Zi with Ku Shen
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 蛇床子溫燥祛濕殺蟲止癢，苦參苦寒清熱燥濕殺蟲。一溫一寒相須為用，燥濕殺蟲止癢之力大增，為治外陰/皮膚濕疹搔癢的經典外用組合，寒熱互制減少單用蛇床子燥烈或苦參苦寒傷陽之偏。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: She Chuang Zi warms and dries Dampness while killing parasites and stopping itching; Ku Shen is bitter and cold, clearing Heat and drying Dampness while also killing parasites. Combined, their warm and cold natures balance each other while their anti-parasitic/anti-itch actions reinforce — a classic external combination for genital/skin eczema with itching.
pairs.indication_zh: 外陰濕疹、婦人陰癢、皮膚濕疹搔癢（外用煎湯洗）
pairs.indication_en: Genital eczema, vaginal itching, and itchy skin eczema (topical wash)
pairs.caution_zh: 僅供外用；蛇床子有毒，不可內服此組合。
pairs.caution_en: For external use only; She Chuang Zi is toxic and this combination should not be taken internally.

pairs.name_en: Qing Dai with Ce Bai Ye and Bai Mao Gen
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 青黛鹹寒清熱涼血解毒，側柏葉苦澀微寒涼血止血，白茅根甘寒涼血止血兼利尿。三藥相須，涼血止血力加強，為血熱妄行之出血（尤其鼻衄）的組合用法，課件明確記載青黛可單用或與此二藥合用。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Qing Dai clears Heat, cools the Blood, and resolves toxicity; Ce Bai Ye and Bai Mao Gen both cool the Blood and stop bleeding, with Bai Mao Gen also promoting urination. Combined they reinforce blood-cooling hemostasis for bleeding from reckless movement of Heat in the Blood, especially epistaxis. Course material explicitly notes Qing Dai can be used alone or combined with these two.
pairs.indication_zh: 血熱妄行之出血，尤其鼻衄；溫毒發斑兼出血
pairs.indication_en: Bleeding from reckless movement of Heat in the Blood, especially epistaxis; warm-toxin maculae with bleeding
pairs.caution_zh: 脾胃虛寒者慎用；青黛不入煎劑久煮。
pairs.caution_en: Caution in Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold; Qing Dai should not be decocted for a prolonged time.

pairs.name_en: Lu Dou with Gan Cao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 綠豆甘寒清熱解毒，甘草甘平調和解毒。兩藥相須，解毒力大增，為傳統解附子、川烏等烏頭類藥物中毒的經典組合；American Dragon 記載高劑量（綠豆120g配甘草60g）可對抗附子中毒。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Lu Dou is sweet and cold, clearing Heat and resolving toxicity; Gan Cao is sweet and neutral, harmonizing and resolving toxicity. Together they mutually reinforce detoxifying action — the classic combination for treating poisoning from aconite-type herbs (Fu Zi, Chuan Wu). American Dragon notes a high-dose combination (120g Lu Dou with 60g Gan Cao) counteracts aconite poisoning.
pairs.indication_zh: 附子、川烏等烏頭類藥物中毒之解毒
pairs.indication_en: Detoxification for poisoning from aconite-type herbs (Fu Zi, Chuan Wu)
pairs.caution_zh: 解毒用量遠高於一般日常劑量，僅適用於中毒急救情境，不可套用一般劑量。
pairs.caution_en: The detoxification dose is far higher than the usual daily dose and applies only to acute-poisoning emergency use, not routine dosing.

pairs.name_en: Bai Zhu with Fu Ling
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 白朮健脾益氣、苦溫燥濕，從中焦運化著手；茯苓甘淡滲濕、健脾寧心，從下焦利水著手。一燥一滲、一補一利，相須為用，是健脾祛濕最基礎的組合（四君子湯、參苓白朮散、苓桂朮甘湯皆用）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Bai Zhu tonifies the Spleen and dries Damp from the middle jiao; Fu Ling is bland and percolates Damp downward while quieting the Heart. Drying paired with percolating, tonifying paired with draining — the base combination for Spleen deficiency with Dampness.
pairs.indication_zh: 脾虛濕盛：食少便溏、腹脹、水腫、痰飲眩悸
pairs.indication_en: Spleen deficiency with Dampness: poor appetite, loose stools, bloating, edema, phlegm-fluid with dizziness and palpitations
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛津虧、無濕邪者不宜；白朮氣滯脹滿者忌。
pairs.caution_en: Not for Yin/fluid deficiency or where no Dampness is present; Bai Zhu is contraindicated in Qi stagnation with distention.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Gan Jiang with Bai Zhu
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 乾薑辛熱溫中散寒、回陽通脈，白朮甘溫健脾益氣燥濕。乾薑溫其陽、白朮補其氣，相使為用，專治中焦虛寒兼濕（理中湯、苓薑朮甘湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Gan Jiang is acrid and hot, warming the middle and dispersing Cold; Bai Zhu tonifies Spleen Qi and dries Damp. Gan Jiang warms the Yang while Bai Zhu supplements the Qi — for Deficiency-Cold of the middle jiao with Dampness (Li Zhong Tang).
pairs.indication_zh: 脾胃虛寒：脘腹冷痛、嘔吐下利、四肢不溫、寒濕腰痛
pairs.indication_en: Spleen-Stomach Deficiency-Cold: cold epigastric pain, vomiting and diarrhea, cold limbs, Cold-Damp low back pain
pairs.caution_zh: 乾薑辛熱，陰虛內熱、實熱及孕婦慎用；血熱妄行者忌。
pairs.caution_en: Gan Jiang is hot: caution in Yin deficiency with Heat, Excess Heat, and pregnancy; avoid in Heat-driven bleeding.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Sheng Jiang with Da Zao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 生薑辛溫發散，走衛分而助衛氣外達；大棗甘平補中，走營分而益營血。一辛一甘、一散一補，相須為用，是「調和營衛」的標準藥對，桂枝湯即用此二味以成其和法。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Sheng Jiang is acrid and dispersing, reaching the Wei level; Da Zao is sweet and supplementing, nourishing the Ying level. Acrid paired with sweet, dispersing paired with tonifying — the standard pairing for harmonizing Ying and Wei, as used in Gui Zhi Tang.
pairs.indication_zh: 營衛不和：發熱汗出惡風、脈浮緩；亦用於補益方中護胃調和
pairs.indication_en: Ying-Wei disharmony: fever with sweating and aversion to wind, floating moderate pulse; also used in tonifying formulas to protect the Stomach
pairs.caution_zh: 陰虛內熱、實熱者不宜；大棗濕熱痰熱者忌。
pairs.caution_en: Not for Yin deficiency with Heat or Excess Heat; Da Zao is contraindicated in Damp-Heat and Phlegm-Heat.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ting Li Zi with Da Zao
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 葶藶子苦寒峻烈，瀉肺平喘、行水消腫，力猛易傷胃氣；大棗甘平補中護胃，緩其峻烈。以大棗之甘緩制葶藶之峻瀉，使攻邪而不傷正（葶藶大棗瀉肺湯）。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ting Li Zi is bitter, cold and drastic — draining Lung fullness and moving water, but harsh on Stomach Qi. Da Zao is sweet and moderating, restraining that harshness so the pathogen is attacked without injuring the upright Qi (Ting Li Da Zao Xie Fei Tang).
pairs.indication_zh: 痰涎壅盛之肺癰、咳逆喘滿不得臥、胸腔積液、水腫
pairs.indication_en: Phlegm congestion in the Lung: lung abscess, cough and wheezing with fullness preventing lying flat, pleural effusion, edema
pairs.caution_zh: 葶藶子峻瀉，肺虛喘促、脾虛便溏及孕婦忌用；非實證不可用。
pairs.caution_en: Ting Li Zi is drastic: contraindicated in Lung-deficiency wheezing, Spleen deficiency with loose stools, and pregnancy; use only for Excess patterns.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17

pairs.name_en: Ban Xia with Chen Pi
pairs.pair_meaning_zh: 半夏辛溫燥濕化痰、降逆止嘔，長於治已成之痰；陳皮理氣健脾、燥濕化痰，長於斷生痰之源。兩藥相須，一化痰一理氣——「治痰先治氣，氣順則痰消」，且二者皆以陳久者為佳，故名二陳湯，為燥濕化痰的基本方根。
pairs.pair_meaning_en: Ban Xia dries Damp, transforms Phlegm and descends rebellion, acting on phlegm already formed; Chen Pi regulates Qi and strengthens the Spleen, cutting off phlegm at its source. Treating Qi to treat phlegm — and since both are best aged (chen), the pair names Er Chen Tang, the root formula for Damp-Phlegm.
pairs.indication_zh: 痰濕證：咳嗽痰多色白、胸膈痞悶、噁心嘔吐、頭暈心悸、舌苔白膩
pairs.indication_en: Damp-Phlegm: cough with profuse white sputum, chest oppression, nausea and vomiting, dizziness and palpitations, white greasy tongue coating
pairs.caution_zh: 燥性偏強，陰虛燥咳、痰中帶血、津傷口渴者忌用；半夏反烏頭類，內服須用炮製品。
pairs.caution_en: Drying: avoid in Yin-deficiency dry cough, blood-streaked sputum, or fluid damage with thirst. Ban Xia is incompatible with aconite-family herbs and only processed forms are taken internally.
sources: NCBAHM CH Content Outline 2026, Appendix B, p.16-17
